<p style="margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 18pt; text-align: left; text-indent: -18pt; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: left; text-indent: 36pt; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">The table above indicates that at <font style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">December 31, 2017, in the event of a 200 basis point increase in interest rates, we would experience a 2.4% increase in net portfolio value. In the event of a 100 basis point decrease in interest rates, we would experience a 4.3% decrease in net portfolio value.</font></p>

<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: left; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: left; text-indent: 36pt; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">Certain shortcomings are inherent in the methodologies used in determining interest rate risk through changes in net portfolio value. Modeling changes in net portfolio value require making certain assumptions that may or may not reflect the manner in which actual yields and costs respond to changes in market interest rates. In this regard, the net portfolio value tables presented assume that the composition of our interest-sensitive assets and liabilities existing at the beginning of a period remains constant over the period being measured and assume that a particular change in interest rates is reflected uniformly across the yield curve regardless of the duration or repricing of specific assets and liabilities. Accordingly, although the net portfolio value tables provide an indication of our interest rate risk exposure at a particular point in time, such measurements are not intended to and do not provide a precise forecast of the effect of changes in market interest rates on our net interest income and will differ from actual results.</p>

<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: left; text-indent: 36pt; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: left; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;"><b>Liquidity and Capital Resources</b></p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: left; text-indent: 36pt; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">Our primary sources of funds are deposits, principal and interest payments on loans, proceeds from sale of loans and advances from the FHLB-Indianapolis. While maturities and scheduled amortization of loans are predictable sources of funds, deposit flows and mortgage prepayments are greatly influenced by market interest rates, economic conditions, and competition. Our most liquid assets are cash and short-term investments including interest-bearing demand deposits. The levels of these assets are dependent on our operating, financing, lending, and investing activities during any given period.</p>

<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: left; text-indent: 36pt; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<div data-thunderdome-xbrl-exclude="1" id="PGBK" style="width: 100%; margin-right: 0pt; margin-left: 0pt;">
<div id="PGNUM" style="width: 100%; text-align: center;">53</div>

<hr style="border: currentColor; border-image: none; width: 100%; height: 2px; color: rgb(0, 0, 0); page-break-after: always; background-color: rgb(0, 0, 0);">
<div id="PGHDR" style="width: 100%; text-align: left;"><a href="#toc">Table of Contents</a></div>
</div>

<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: left; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: left; text-indent: 36pt; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">Our cash flows are comprised of three primary classifications: cash flows from operating activities, investing activities, and financing activities. Net cash provided by operating activities was $208,000 for the year ended December 31, 2017. Net cash used in investing activities, which consists primarily of net change in loans receivable and proceeds from sale of foreclosed assets was $17.1 million for the year ended December 31, 2017. Net cash provided by financing activities, which is comprised of net change in deposits and net changes in borrowings, was $22.8 million for the year ended December 31, 2017.</p>

<p style="margin: 0pt 7.5pt; text-align: left; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: left; text-indent: 36pt; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">At December 31, 2017, we exceeded all of our regulatory capital requirements with a Tier 1 leverage capital level of $14.0 million, or 11.3% of adjusted average assets, which is above the required level of $4.9 million or 4.0%; total risk-based capital of $15.1 million, or 16.3% of risk-weighted assets, which is above the required level of $7.4 million, or 8.0%; and common equity Tier 1 capital of $14.0 million, or 15.1% of risk-weighted assets, which is above the required level of $4.2 million, or 4.5% of risk-weighted assets. Accordingly, New Buffalo Savings Bank was categorized as well capitalized at December 31, 2017. Management is not aware of any conditions or events since the most recent notification that would change our category.</p>

<p style="margin: 0pt 7.5pt; text-align: left; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: left; text-indent: 36pt; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">At December 31, 2017, we had outstanding commitments to originate loans totaling $1.3 million. Commitments under available lines of credit and undisbursed construction loans totaled $10.5 million and $498,000, respectively. We anticipate that we will have sufficient funds available to meet our current loan origination commitments. Certificates of deposit that are scheduled to mature in less than one year from December 31, 2017 totaled $13.7 million. Management expects that a substantial portion of the maturing certificates of deposit will be renewed. However, if a substantial portion of these deposits is not retained, we may utilize FHLB-Indianapolis advances or raise</p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: left; text-indent: 36pt; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;"><b><i>Off-Balance Sheet Arrangements. </i></b><font style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">In the normal course of operations, we engage in a variety of financial transactions that, in accordance with U.S. generally accepted accounting principles, are not recorded in our financial statements. These transactions involve, to varying degrees, elements of credit, interest rate and liquidity risk. Such transactions are used primarily to manage customers&rsquo; requests for funding and take the form of loan commitments, lines of credit and standby letters of credit. </font></p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: left; text-indent: 36pt; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">We also <font style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">generally sell our conforming, fixed-rate one- to four-family residential real estate loans in transactions with the FHLB-Indianapolis, through its mortgage purchase program, and the Federal Home Loan Mortgage Corporation (FHLMC). In 2017, we sold $2.4 million of these loans. Subject to our ongoing interest rate risk analysis, we generally intend to continue to sell our conforming, fixed-rate one- to four-family residential real estate loans that we originate.&nbsp; Under specific circumstances we may be obligated to repurchase certain loans as required by the sales agreement. Based on our historical experience, our reserve at December 31, 2017 was deemed immaterial. </font></p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: left; text-indent: 36pt; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">For information about our loan commitments, unused lines of credit and standby letters of credit, see Note 14 of the Notes to our Consolidated Financial Statements <font style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">beginning on page F-1 of this Annual Report.</font></p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: left; text-indent: 36pt; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">We have not engaged in any other off-balance-sheet transactions in the normal course of our lending activities.</p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: left; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;"><b>Recent Accounting Pronouncements </b></p>

<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: left; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: left; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;"><b>Impact of Inflation and Changing Prices</b></p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: left; text-indent: 36pt; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">The financial statements and related data presented herein have been prepared in accordance with generally accepted accounting principles in the <font style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">United States of America which require the measurement of financial position and operating results in terms of historical dollars without considering changes in the relative purchasing power of money over time due to inflation. The primary impact of inflation on our operations is reflected in increased operating costs. Unlike most industrial companies, virtually all of the assets and liabilities of a financial institution are monetary in nature. As a result, interest rates, generally, have a more significant impact on a financial institution&rsquo;s performance than does inflation. Interest rates do not necessarily move in the same direction or to the same extent as the prices of goods and services.</font></p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<div data-thunderdome-xbrl-exclude="1" id="PGBK" style="width: 100%; margin-right: 0pt; margin-left: 0pt;">
<div id="PGNUM" style="width: 100%; text-align: center; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">55</div>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: left; text-indent: 36pt; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">Not required for smaller reporting companies.</p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt;"><b><u><a id="8" name="8"></a>ITEM 8.&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; <font style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">Financial Statements and Supplementary Data</font></u></b></p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: left; text-indent: 36pt; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">The Company<font style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">&rsquo;s Consolidated Financial Statements are presented in this Annual Report on Form 10-K beginning at page F-1.</font></p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt;"><b><u><a id="9" name="9"></a>ITEM 9.&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; <font style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">Changes in and Disagreements with Accountants on Accounting and Financial Disclosure</font> </u></b></p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: 36pt; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;"><font style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">Information concerning change in our accountants is incorporated herein by reference from the Proxy Statement, specifically the section captioned &ldquo;Change in Accountants.&rdquo;</font></p>

<p style="margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 72pt; text-align: left; text-indent: -72pt; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;"><b>&nbsp;</b></p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt;"><u><b><a id="9a" name="9a"></a>ITEM 9A.&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;<font style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">Controls and Procedures</font> </b></u></p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: left; text-indent: 36pt; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">(a)<font style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;An evaluation was performed under the supervision and with the participation of the Company&rsquo;s management, including the President and Chief Executive Officer and the Chief Financial Officer, of the effectiveness of the design and operation of the Company&rsquo;s disclosure controls and procedures (as defined in Rule 13a-15(e) promulgated under the Securities and Exchange Act of 1934, as amended) as of December 31, 2017. Based on that evaluation, the Company&rsquo;s management, including the President and Chief Executive Officer and the Chief Financial Officer, concluded that the Company&rsquo;s disclosure controls and procedures were effective.</font></p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: left; text-indent: 36pt; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">During the <font style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">year ended December 31, 2017, there have been no changes in the Company&rsquo;s internal control over financial reporting that have materially affected, or are reasonably likely to materially affect, the Company&rsquo;s internal control over<u> </u>financial reporting.</font></p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: left; text-indent: 36pt; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">(b)<font style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;Management&rsquo;s annual report on internal control over financial reporting. </font></p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: left; text-indent: 36pt; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">Management of the Company is responsible for establishing and maintaining adequate internal control over financial reporting.</p>

<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: left; text-indent: 36pt; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;"><b>&nbsp;</b></p>

<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: left; text-indent: 36pt; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">The Company<font style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">&rsquo;s internal control over financial reporting is a process designed to provide reasonable assurance regarding the reliability of financial reporting and the preparation of financial statements for external purposes in accordance with accounting principles generally accepted in the United States of America. The Company&rsquo;s internal control over financial reporting includes those policies and procedures that (i) pertain to the maintenance of records that, in reasonable detail, accurately and fairly reflect the transactions and dispositions of the assets of the Company; (ii) provide reasonable assurance that transactions are recorded as necessary to permit preparation of financial statements in accordance with accounting principles generally accepted in the United States of America, and that receipts and expenditures of the Company are being made only in accordance with authorizations of management and directors of the Company; and (iii) provide reasonable assurance regarding prevention or timely detection of unauthorized acquisition, use, or disposition of the Company&rsquo;s assets that could have a material effect on the financial statements.</font></p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<div data-thunderdome-xbrl-exclude="1" id="PGBK" style="width: 100%; margin-right: 0pt; margin-left: 0pt;">
<div id="PGNUM" style="width: 100%; text-align: center; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">56</div>

<hr style="border: currentColor; border-image: none; width: 100%; height: 2px; color: rgb(0, 0, 0); page-break-after: always; background-color: rgb(0, 0, 0);">
<div id="PGHDR" style="width: 100%; text-align: left;"><a href="#toc">Table of Contents</a></div>
</div>

<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: left; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: left; text-indent: 36pt; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">Because of its inherent limitations, internal control over financial reporting may not prevent or detect misstatements. Also, projections of any evaluation of effectiveness to future periods are subject to the risk that controls may become inadequate because of changes in conditions, or that the degree of compliance with the policies or procedures may deteriorate.</p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: left; text-indent: 24.5pt; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">Management, including the principal executive officer and principal financial officer, assessed the effectiveness of the Company<font style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">&rsquo;s internal control over financial reporting as of December 31, 2017, based on the criteria set forth by the Committee of Sponsoring Organizations of the Treadway Commission (&ldquo;COSO&rdquo;) in &ldquo;Internal Control-Integrated Framework (2013).&rdquo;&nbsp;Based on such assessment, management believes that, as of December 31, 2017, the Company&rsquo;s internal control over financial reporting is effective, based on those criteria. </font></p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: left; text-indent: 24.5pt; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">This annual report does not include an attestation report of the Company<font style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">&rsquo;s independent registered public accounting firm regarding internal control over financial reporting.&nbsp;Management&rsquo;s report was not subject to attestation by the Company&rsquo;s independent registered public accounting firm pursuant to provisions of the Dodd-Frank Act that permit the Company to provide only management&rsquo;s report in this annual report. </font></p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: center; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;"><b><a id="report" name="report"></a>Report of Independent Registered Public Accounting Firm</b></p>

<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: left; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: left; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: left; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">Audit Committee<font style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">, Board of Directors and Management<br>
New Bancorp, Inc.<br>
New Buffalo, Michigan </font></p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: left; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: left; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;"><b>Opinion on the Financial Statements</b></p>

<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: left; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: left; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">We have audited the accompanying consolidated balance sheets of <font style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">New Bancorp, Inc. (the &quot;Company&quot;) as of December 31, 2017 and 2016, the related consolidated statements of operations, changes in shareholders&#39; equity and cash flows for each of the years then ended and the related notes (collectively referred to as the &quot;financial statements&quot;). In our opinion, the consolidated financial statements referred to above present fairly, in all material respects, the financial position of the Company as of December 31, 2017 and 2016, and the results of its operations and its cash flows for each of the years then ended, in conformity with accounting principles generally accepted in the United States of America.</font></p>

<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: left; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: left; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;"><b>Basis for Opinion</b></p>

<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: left; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: left; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">These financial statements are the responsibility of the Company&#39;s management. Our responsibility is to express an opinion on the Company&#39;s financial statements based on our audits.</p>

<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: left; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: left; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">We are a public accounting firm registered with the Public Company Accounting Oversight Board (United States) (&quot;PCAOB&quot;) and are required to be independent with respect to the Company in accordance with the U.S. federal securities laws and the applicable rules and regulations of the Securities and Exchange Commission and the PCAOB.</p>

<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: left; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: left; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">We conducted our audits in accordance with the standards of the PCAOB. Those standards require that we plan and perform the audit to obtain reasonable assurance about whether the financial statements are free of material misstatement, whether due to error or fraud. The Company is not required to have, nor were we engaged to perform, an audit of its internal control over financial reporting. As part of our audits we are required to obtain an understanding of internal control over financial reporting but not for the purpose of expressing an opinion on the effectiveness of the Company&#39;s internal control over financial reporting. Accordingly, we express no such opinion.</p>

<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: left; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: left; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">Our audits included performing procedures to assess the risks of material misstatement of the financial statements, whether due to error or fraud, and performing procedures that respond to those risks. Such procedures include examining, on a test basis, evidence regarding the amounts and disclosures in the financial statements. Our audits also included evaluating the accounting principles used and significant estimates made by management, as well as evaluating the overall presentation of the financial statements. We believe that our audits provide a reasonable basis for our opinion.</p>

<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: left; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: left; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: left; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">/s/ BKD, LLP</p>

<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: left; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">BKD, LLP</p>

<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: left; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: left; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">We have served as the Company&#39;s auditor since <font style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">2014.</font></p>

<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: left; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: center; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;"><b><a id="notes" name="notes"></a>Notes to Consolidated Financial Statements</b></p>

<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: center; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;"><b>December 31, 2017 and 2016</b></p>

<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: left; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: left; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<div contenteditable="false" docsect="9" id="11472" sectdesc="Note to Financial Statements">&nbsp;</div>

<div data-td-parse-id="1" data-td-statement-type="note" data-td-v2v-id="1521299620554" id="thunderdome-statement-848064">
<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt;"><b>Note <em data-td-fact-id="29242922" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;">1:</em>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; </b><font style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;"><b>Nature of Operations and Summary of Significant Accounting Policies</b></font></p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 14.4pt; text-align: left; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;"><i><b>Nature of Operations</b></i></p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 28.8pt; text-align: left; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">New Bancorp, Inc. was formed to serve as the stock holding company for New Buffalo Savings Bank <font style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">(the &ldquo;Bank&rdquo;) upon completion of its mutual-to-stock conversion. The conversion was effective <em data-td-invalid-detail="1" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;"> October 19, 2015. </em>New Bancorp, Inc. issued <em data-td-fact-id="29242923" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;">696,600</em> shares at an offering price of <em data-td-fact-id="29242924" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;">$10.00</em> per share. </font></p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 28.8pt; text-align: left; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">The<font style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;"> Bank conducts a general banking business in southwestern Michigan which primarily consists of attracting deposits from the general public and applying those funds to the origination of loans for residential, consumer and nonresidential purposes. </font></p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 14.4pt; text-align: left; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;"><i><b>Principles of Consolidation</b></i></p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 28.8pt; text-align: left; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">The consolidated financial statements include New Bancorp, Inc. and its wholly-owned subsidiary the Bank, together referred to as the &ldquo;Company.&rdquo; Intercompany transactions and balances have been eliminated in consolidation.</p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 14.4pt; text-align: left; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;"><i><b>Use of Estimates</b></i></p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 28.8pt; text-align: left; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">The preparation of financial statements in conformity with accounting principles generally accepted in the <font style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">United States of America requires management to make estimates and assumptions that affect the reported amounts of assets and liabilities and disclosure of contingent assets and liabilities at the date of the financial statements and the reported amounts of revenues and expenses during the reporting period. Actual results could differ from those estimates. </font></p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 28.8pt; text-align: left; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">Material estimates that are particularly susceptible to significant change relate to the determination of the allowance for loan losses, valuation of real estate acquired in connection with foreclosures or in satisfaction of loans<font style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">, mortgage servicing rights, valuation of deferred tax assets and fair values of financial instruments. </font></p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 14.4pt; text-align: left; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;"><i><b>Reclassifications</b></i></p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 28.8pt; text-align: left; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">Certain reclassifications have been made to the <em data-td-invalid-detail="1" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;"> December 31, </em><em data-td-fact-id="29242925" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;">201</em><font style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;"><em data-td-fact-id="29242926" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;">7</em> financial statements to conform to the <em data-td-invalid-detail="1" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;"> December 31, 2016 </em>financial statement presentation. These reclassifications had <em data-td-fact-id="29242927" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;">no</em> effect on our results of operations</font></p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 14.4pt; text-align: left; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;"><i><b>Cash <font style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">and Cash Equivalents</font></b></i></p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 28.8pt; text-align: left; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">The <font style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">Company considers all liquid investments with original maturities of <em data-td-fact-id="29242928" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;">three</em> months or less to be cash equivalents. At <em data-td-invalid-detail="1" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;"> December 31, 2017, </em>the Company&rsquo;s cash accounts exceeded federally insured limits by approximately <em data-td-fact-id="29242929" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;">$11.6</em> million. Additionally, approximately <em data-td-fact-id="29242930" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;">$1.9</em> million of cash in total is held by the Federal Home Loan Bank and Federal Reserve Bank as of <em data-td-invalid-detail="1" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;"> December 31, 2017, </em>which is <em data-td-fact-id="29242931" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;">not</em> federally insured. </font></p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<div data-thunderdome-xbrl-exclude="1" id="PGBK" style="width: 100%; margin-right: 0pt; margin-left: 0pt;">
<div id="PGNUM" style="width: 100%; text-align: center; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">F-7</div>

<hr style="border: currentColor; border-image: none; width: 100%; height: 2px; color: rgb(0, 0, 0); page-break-after: always; background-color: rgb(0, 0, 0);">
<div id="PGHDR" style="width: 100%; text-align: left;"><a href="#toc">Table of Contents</a></div>
</div>

<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: left; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: center; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 12pt;"><b>New Bancorp, Inc.</b></p>

<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: center; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;"><b>Notes to Consolidated Financial Statements</b></p>

<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: center; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;"><b><em data-td-invalid-detail="1" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;">December 31, 2017 </em>and <em data-td-fact-id="29242932" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;">2016</em></b></p>

<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: left; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 14.4pt; text-align: left; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;"><i><b>Interest-<font style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">earning Deposits in Banks</font></b></i></p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 28.8pt; text-align: left; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">Interest-earning <font style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">time deposits in banks mature within the year <em data-td-fact-id="29242933" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;">2018</em> and are carried at cost. </font></p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 14.4pt; text-align: left; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;"><i><b>Loans Held for Sale</b></i></p>

<p style="margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 28.8pt; text-align: left; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 28.8pt; text-align: left; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">L<font style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">oans originated and intended for sale in the secondary market are carried at the lower of cost or fair value in the aggregate. Net unrealized losses, if any, are recognized through a valuation allowance by charges to noninterest income. Gains and losses on loan sales are recorded in noninterest income, and direct loan origination costs and fees are deferred at origination of the loan and are recognized in noninterest income upon sale of the loan.</font></p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 14.4pt; text-align: left; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;"><i><b>Loans</b></i></p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 28.8pt; text-align: left; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">Loans that management has the intent and ability to hold for the foreseeable future or until maturity or payoffs are reported at their outstanding principal balances adjusted for unearned income, charge-offs, the allowance for loan losses<font style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;"> and any unamortized deferred fees or costs on originated loans.</font></p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 28.8pt; text-align: left; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">For loans amortized at cost, interest income is accrued based on the unpaid princip<font style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">al balance. Loan origination fees, net of certain direct origination costs, as well as premiums and discounts, are deferred and amortized as a level yield adjustment over the respective term of the loan.</font></p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 28.8pt; text-align: left; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">The accrual of interest on mortgage and commercial loans is discontinued at the time the loan is <em data-td-fact-id="29242934" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;">90</em> days past due unless the credit is well-secured and <font style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">in process of collection. Past-due status is based on contractual terms of the loan. In all cases, loans are placed on nonaccrual or charged off at an earlier date if collection of principal or interest is considered doubtful.</font></p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 28.8pt; text-align: left; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">All interest accrued but <em data-td-fact-id="29242935" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;">not</em> collected for loans that are placed on nonaccrual or charged off <font style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">is reversed against interest income. The interest on these loans is accounted for on the cash-basis or cost-recovery method, until qualifying for return to accrual status. Loans are returned to accrual status when all the principal and interest amounts contractually due are brought current and future payments are reasonably assured.</font></p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<div data-thunderdome-xbrl-exclude="1" id="PGBK" style="width: 100%; margin-right: 0pt; margin-left: 0pt;">
<div id="PGNUM" style="width: 100%; text-align: center; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">F-8</div>

<hr style="border: currentColor; border-image: none; width: 100%; height: 2px; color: rgb(0, 0, 0); page-break-after: always; background-color: rgb(0, 0, 0);">
<div id="PGHDR" style="width: 100%; text-align: left;"><a href="#toc">Table of Contents</a></div>
</div>

<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: left; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: center; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 12pt;"><b>New Bancorp, Inc.</b></p>

<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: center; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;"><b>Notes to Consolidated Financial Statements</b></p>

<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: center; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;"><b><em data-td-invalid-detail="1" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;">December 31, 2017 </em>and <em data-td-fact-id="29242936" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;">2016</em></b></p>

<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: left; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 14.4pt; text-align: left; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;"><i><b>Allowance for Loan Losses</b></i></p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 28.8pt; text-align: left; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">The allowance for loan losses is established as losses are estimated to have occurred through a provision for loan losses charged to income. Loan losses are charged against the allowance when ma<font style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">nagement believes the uncollectibility of a loan balance is confirmed. Subsequent recoveries, if any, are credited to the allowance.</font></p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 28.8pt; text-align: left; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">The <font style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">allowance for loan losses is evaluated on a regular basis by management and is based upon management&rsquo;s periodic review of the collectibility of the loans in light of historical experience, the nature and volume of the loan portfolio, adverse situations that <em data-td-invalid-detail="1" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;"> may </em>affect the borrower&rsquo;s ability to repay, estimated value of any underlying collateral and prevailing economic conditions. This evaluation is inherently subjective as it requires estimates that are susceptible to significant revision as more information becomes available. The allowance consists of allocated and general components. The allocated component relates to loans that are classified as impaired. For those loans that are classified as impaired, an allowance is established when the discounted cash flows (or collateral value or observable market price) of the impaired loan is lower than the carrying value of that loan. The general component covers nonclassified loans and is based on historical charge-off experience and expected loss given default derived from the Bank&rsquo;s internal risk rating process. Other adjustments <em data-td-invalid-detail="1" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;"> may </em>be made to the allowance for pools of loans after an assessment of internal or external influences on credit quality that are <em data-td-fact-id="29242937" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;">not</em> fully reflected in the historical loss or risk rating data.</font></p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 28.8pt; text-align: left; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">A loan is considered impaired when, based on current information and events, it is probable that the <font style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">Company will be unable to collect the scheduled payments of principal or interest when due according to the contractual terms of the loan agreement. Factors considered by management in determining impairment include payment status, collateral value and the probability of collecting scheduled principal and interest payments when due. Loans that experience insignificant payment delays and payment shortfalls generally are <em data-td-fact-id="29242938" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;">not</em> classified as impaired. Management determines the significance of payment delays and payment shortfalls on a case-by-case basis, taking into consideration all of the circumstances surrounding the loan and the borrower, including the length of the delay, the reasons for the delay, the borrower&rsquo;s prior payment record and the amount of the shortfall in relation to the principal and interest owed. Impairment is measured on a loan-by-loan basis for commercial and construction loans by either the present value of expected future cash flows discounted at the loan&rsquo;s effective interest rate, the loan&rsquo;s obtainable market price or the fair value of the collateral if the loan is collateral dependent.</font></p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 28.8pt; text-align: left; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">Groups of loans with similar risk characteristics are collectively evaluated for impairment based on the group<font style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">&rsquo;s historical loss experience adjusted for changes in trends, conditions and other relevant factors that affect repayment of the loans. Accordingly, the Company does <em data-td-fact-id="29242939" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;">not</em> separately identify individual consumer and residential loans for impairment measurements, unless such loans are the subject of a restructuring agreement due to financial difficulties of the borrower. </font></p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<div data-thunderdome-xbrl-exclude="1" id="PGBK" style="width: 100%; margin-right: 0pt; margin-left: 0pt;">
<div id="PGNUM" style="width: 100%; text-align: center; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">F-9</div>

<hr style="border: currentColor; border-image: none; width: 100%; height: 2px; color: rgb(0, 0, 0); page-break-after: always; background-color: rgb(0, 0, 0);">

<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: left; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: center; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 12pt;"><b>New Bancorp, Inc.</b></p>

<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: center; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;"><b>Notes to Consolidated Financial Statements</b></p>

<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: center; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;"><b><em data-td-invalid-detail="1" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;">December 31, 2017 </em>and <em data-td-fact-id="29242940" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;">2016</em></b></p>

<p style="margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 28.8pt; text-align: left; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 14.4pt; text-align: left; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;"><i><b>Premises and Equipment</b></i></p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 28.8pt; text-align: left; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">Depreciable assets are stated at cost less accumulated depreciation. Depreciation is charged to expense using the straight-line method over the estimated useful lives of the assets.<font style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;"> The estimated useful lives of depreciable assets is <em data-td-fact-id="29242941" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;">39</em> years for buildings, <em data-td-fact-id="29242942" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;">10</em> years for building improvements, and <em data-td-fact-id="29242943" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;">three</em> to <em data-td-fact-id="29242944" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;">seven</em> years for furniture, fixtures and equipment. Maintenance and repairs are expensed and major improvements are capitalized. </font></p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 14.4pt; text-align: left; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;"><i><b>Federal Home Loan Bank Stock</b></i></p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 28.8pt; text-align: left; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">Federal Home Loan Bank<font style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;"> (&ldquo;FHLB&rdquo;) stock is a required investment for institutions that are members of the FHLB system. The required investment in the common stock is based on a predetermined formula, carried at cost and evaluated for impairment. </font></p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 14.4pt; text-align: left; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;"><i><b>Foreclosed <font style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">Real Estate Held for Sale </font></b></i></p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 28.8pt; text-align: left; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">Real estate<font style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;"> acquired through, or in lieu of, loan foreclosure is held for sale and is initially recorded at fair value less cost to sell at the date of foreclosure, establishing a new cost basis. Subsequent to foreclosure, valuations are periodically performed by management and the assets are carried at the lower of carrying amount or fair value less cost to sell. Revenue and expenses from operations and changes in the valuation allowance are included in net income or expense from foreclosed assets. There were <em data-td-fact-id="29242945" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;">no</em> loans in the process of foreclosure at <em data-td-invalid-detail="1" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;"> December 31, 2017. </em>Foreclosed real estate held for sale consisted of residential real estate at <em data-td-invalid-detail="1" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;"> December 31, 2016. </em></font></p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 14.4pt; text-align: left; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;"><i><b>Servicing Rights</b></i></p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 28.8pt; text-align: left; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">S<font style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">ervicing assets are recognized separately when rights are acquired through purchase or through sale of financial assets. Under the servicing assets and liabilities accounting guidance (ASC&nbsp;<em data-td-fact-id="29242946" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;">860</em>-<em data-td-fact-id="29242947" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;">50</em>), servicing rights resulting from the sale or securitization of loans originated by the Company are initially measured at fair value at the date of transfer. The Company subsequently measures the servicing asset using either the fair value or the amortization method. The Company has elected to initially and subsequently measure the servicing rights for loans sold with servicing retained loans using the amortization method. Under the amortization method, servicing rights are amortized in proportion to and over the period of estimated net servicing income. The amortized assets are assessed for impairment based on fair value at each reporting date.</font></p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 28.8pt; text-align: left; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">Fair value is based on market<font style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;"> prices for comparable servicing contracts, when available, or alternatively, is based on a valuation model that calculates the present value of estimated future net servicing income. The valuation model incorporates assumptions that market participants would use in estimating future net servicing income, such as the cost to service, the discount rate, the custodial earnings rate, an inflation rate, ancillary income, prepayment speeds and default rates and losses. These variables change from quarter to quarter as market conditions and projected interest rates change, and <em data-td-invalid-detail="1" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;"> may </em>have an adverse impact on the value of the mortgage servicing right and <em data-td-invalid-detail="1" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;"> may </em>result in a reduction to noninterest income. </font></p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<div data-thunderdome-xbrl-exclude="1" id="PGBK" style="width: 100%; margin-right: 0pt; margin-left: 0pt;">
<div id="PGNUM" style="width: 100%; text-align: center; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">F-10</div>

<hr style="border: currentColor; border-image: none; width: 100%; height: 2px; color: rgb(0, 0, 0); page-break-after: always; background-color: rgb(0, 0, 0);">
<div id="PGHDR" style="width: 100%; text-align: left;"><a href="#toc">Table of Contents</a></div>
</div>

<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: left; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: center; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 12pt;"><b>New Bancorp, Inc.</b></p>

<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: center; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;"><b>Notes to Consolidated Financial Statements</b></p>

<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: center; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;"><b><em data-td-invalid-detail="1" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;">December 31, 2017 </em>and <em data-td-fact-id="29242948" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;">2016</em></b></p>

<p style="margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 28.8pt; text-align: left; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 28.8pt; text-align: left; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 28.8pt; text-align: left; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">Each class of separately recognized servicing assets subsequently measured using the amortization method are evaluated and measured for impairment. Impairment is determined by stratifying rights into tranches based on predominant characteristics, such as interest rate, loan type and investor type. Impairment is recognized through a valuation allowance for an individual tranche, to the extent that fair value is less than the carrying amount of the servicing assets for that tranche. The valuation allowance is adjusted to reflect changes in the measurement of impairment after the initial measurement of impairment. Fair value in excess of the carrying amount of servicing assets for that stratum is <em data-td-fact-id="29242949" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;">not</em> recognized.</p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 28.8pt; text-align: left; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">Servicing fee income is recorded for fees earned for servicing loans. The fees are based on a contractual percenta<font style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">ge of the outstanding principal or a fixed amount per loan and are recorded as income when earned. The amortization of mortgage servicing rights is netted against loan servicing fee income. </font></p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 14.4pt; text-align: left; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;"><i><b>Transfers of Financial Assets</b></i></p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 28.8pt; text-align: left; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">Transfers of financial assets are accounted for as sales, when control over the assets has been surrendered. Control over transferred assets is de<font style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">emed to be surrendered when (<em data-td-fact-id="29242950" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;">1</em>)&nbsp;the assets have been isolated from the Company &mdash;put presumptively beyond the reach of the transferor and its creditors, even in bankruptcy or other receivership, (<em data-td-fact-id="29242951" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;">2</em>)&nbsp;the transferee obtains the right (free of conditions that constrain it from taking advantage of that right) to pledge or exchange the transferred assets and (<em data-td-fact-id="29242952" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;">3</em>)&nbsp;the Company does <em data-td-fact-id="29242953" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;">not</em> maintain effective control over the transferred assets through an agreement to repurchase them before their maturity or the ability to unilaterally cause the holder to return specific assets.</font></p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 14.4pt; text-align: left; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;"><i><b>Income Taxes</b></i></p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 28.8pt; text-align: left; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">The <font style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">Company accounts for income taxes in accordance with income tax accounting guidance (ASC&nbsp;<em data-td-fact-id="29242954" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;">740,</em> <i>Income Taxes</i>). The income tax accounting guidance results in <em data-td-fact-id="29242955" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;">two</em> components of income tax expense: current and deferred. Current income tax expense reflects taxes to be paid or refunded for the current period by applying the provisions of the enacted tax law to the taxable income or excess of deductions over revenues. The Company determines deferred income taxes using the liability (or balance sheet) method. Under this method, the net deferred tax asset or liability is based on the tax effects of the differences between the book and tax bases of assets and liabilities, and enacted changes in tax rates and laws are recognized in the period in which they occur. Deferred income tax expense results from changes in deferred tax assets and liabilities between periods. Deferred tax assets are reduced by a valuation allowance if, based on the weight of evidence available, it is more likely than <em data-td-fact-id="29242956" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;">not</em> that some portion or all of a deferred tax asset will <em data-td-fact-id="29242957" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;">not</em> be realized.</font></p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 28.8pt; text-align: left; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">T<font style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">ax positions are recognized if it is more likely than <em data-td-fact-id="29242958" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;">not,</em> based on the technical merits, that the tax position will be realized or sustained upon examination. The term more likely than <em data-td-fact-id="29242959" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;">not</em> means a likelihood of more than <em data-td-fact-id="29242960" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;">50</em> percent; the terms examined and upon examination also include resolution of the related appeals or litigation processes, if any. A tax position that meets the more-likely-than-<em data-td-fact-id="29242961" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;">not</em> recognition threshold is initially and subsequently measured as the largest amount of tax benefit that has a greater than <em data-td-fact-id="29242962" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;">50</em> percent likelihood of being realized upon settlement with a taxing authority that has full knowledge of all relevant information. The determination of whether</font>&nbsp;or <em data-td-fact-id="29242963" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;">not</em> a tax position has met the more-likely-than-<em data-td-fact-id="29242964" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;">not</em> recognition threshold con<font style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">siders the facts, circumstances and information available at the reporting date and is subject to management&rsquo;s judgment. </font></p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<div data-thunderdome-xbrl-exclude="1" id="PGBK" style="width: 100%; margin-right: 0pt; margin-left: 0pt;">
<div id="PGNUM" style="width: 100%; text-align: center; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">F-11</div>

<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: left; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: center; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 12pt;"><b>New Bancorp, Inc.</b></p>

<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: center; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;"><b>Notes to Consolidated Financial Statements</b></p>

<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: center; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;"><b><em data-td-invalid-detail="1" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;">December 31, 2017 </em>and <em data-td-fact-id="29242965" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;">2016</em></b></p>

<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: left; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: left; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 28.8pt; text-align: left; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">The <font style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">Company recognizes interest and penalties on income taxes as a component of income tax expense.</font></p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 28.8pt; text-align: left; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">The <font style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">Company has established a full valuation allowance for its net deferred tax asset as of <em data-td-invalid-detail="1" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;"> December 31, 2017 </em>and <em data-td-fact-id="29242966" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;">2016.</em> See Note <em data-td-fact-id="29242967" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;">9,</em> Income Taxes, for further information. </font></p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 14.4pt; text-align: left; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;"><i><b>Bank<font style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;"> Owned Life Insurance</font></b></i></p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 28.8pt; text-align: left; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">The cash surrender value of <font style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">bank owned life insurance policies represents the value of life insurance policies on certain current and former officers of the Company for which the Company is the beneficiary. The Company accounts for these assets using the cash surrender value method in determining the carrying value of the insurance policies. </font></p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 14.4pt; text-align: left; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;"><i><b>Comprehensive Income (Loss)</b></i></p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 28.8pt; text-align: left; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">Comprehensive income <font style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">(loss) consists of net income (loss) and other comprehensive income. The Company had <em data-td-fact-id="29242968" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;">no</em> elements of other comprehensive income at <em data-td-invalid-detail="1" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;"> December 31, 2017 </em>and <em data-td-fact-id="29242969" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;">2016.</em> </font></p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 14.4pt; text-align: left; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;"><i><b>Income (L<font style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">oss) Per Share</font></b></i></p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 29.4pt; text-align: justify; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">Basic <font style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">income (loss) per share excludes dilution and is calculated by dividing net income (loss) applicable to common stock by the weighted-average number of shares of common stock outstanding during the period, less unallocated Employee Stock Ownership Plan (the &ldquo;ESOP&rdquo;) shares. </font></p>

<p style="margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 29.4pt; text-align: justify; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 29.4pt; text-align: justify; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">Diluted earnings per share is computed in a manner similar to that of basic earnings per share except that the weighted-average number of common shares outstanding is increased to include the number of incremental common shares that would have been outstanding if all potentially dilutive common stock equivalents were issued during the year, as well as any adjustment to income that would result from the assumed issuance. Potential common shares that <em data-td-invalid-detail="1" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;"> may </em>be issued by the Company relate to outstanding stock options and restricted stock awards and are determined using the treasury stock method.</p>

<p style="margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 28.8pt; text-align: justify; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 29.4pt; text-align: justify; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">Unallocated common shares held by the Company<font style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">&rsquo;s ESOP are shown as a reduction in shareholders&rsquo; equity and are excluded from weighted-average common shares outstanding for both basic and diluted earnings (loss) per share calculations until they are committed to be released.</font></p>

<p style="margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 29.4pt; text-align: justify; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 14.4pt; text-align: left; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;"><i><b>Emerging Growth Company Critical Accounting Policy Disclosure</b></i></p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 29.4pt; text-align: justify; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">W<font style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">e are an &ldquo;emerging growth company,&rdquo; as defined in Section&nbsp;<em data-td-fact-id="29242970" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;">2</em>(a) of the Securities Act of <em data-td-fact-id="29242971" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;">1933</em> (the &ldquo;Securities Act&rdquo;), as modified by the Jumpstart Our Business Startups Act of <em data-td-fact-id="29242972" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;">2012</em> ( the &ldquo;JOBS Act&rdquo;). We are eligible to take advantage of certain exemptions from various reporting requirements that are applicable to other public companies that are <em data-td-fact-id="29242973" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;">not</em> emerging growth<i><b> </b></i>companies.&nbsp; </font></p>

<p style="margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 29.4pt; text-align: justify; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">&nbsp;</p>
