<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: center; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 12pt;"><b>New Bancorp, Inc.</b></p>

<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: center; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;"><b>Notes to Consolidated Financial Statements</b></p>

<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: center; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;"><b><em data-td-invalid-detail="1" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;">December 31, 2017 </em>and <em data-td-fact-id="29242974" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;">2016</em></b></p>

<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: left; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: left; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 29.4pt; text-align: justify; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">As an &ldquo;emerging<font style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;"> growth company&rdquo; we have elected to use the extended transition period to delay adoption of new or revised accounting pronouncements applicable to public companies until such pronouncements are made applicable to private companies. Accordingly, our financial statements <em data-td-invalid-detail="1" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;"> may </em><em data-td-fact-id="29242975" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;">not</em> be comparable to the financial statements of public companies that comply with such new or revised accounting standards. </font></p>

<p style="margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 29.4pt; text-align: justify; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">&nbsp;</p>
</div>

<div contenteditable="false" docsect="9" id="11473" sectdesc="Note to Financial Statements">&nbsp;</div>

<div data-td-parse-id="1" data-td-statement-type="note" data-td-v2v-id="1521299628423" id="thunderdome-statement-848065">
<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: justify; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;"><b>Note <em data-td-fact-id="29242976" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;">2:</em>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; </b><font style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;"><b>Restriction on Cash and Due From Banks</b></font></p>

<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: justify; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 29.4pt; text-align: justify; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">The <font style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">Company is generally required to maintain reserve funds in cash and/or on deposit with the Federal Reserve Bank. The Company had <em data-td-fact-id="29242977" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;">no</em> reserve balance requirement at <em data-td-invalid-detail="1" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;"> December 31, 2017. </em></font></p>

<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: left; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: center; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 12pt;"><b>New Bancorp, Inc.</b></p>

<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: center; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;"><b>Notes to Consolidated Financial Statements</b></p>

<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: center; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;"><b><em data-td-invalid-detail="1" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;">December 31, 2017 </em>and <em data-td-fact-id="29242985" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;">2016</em></b></p>

<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: center; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: left; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">The risk characteristics<font style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;"> applicable to each segment of the loan portfolio are described below:</font></p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 28.8pt; text-align: left; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;"><b>Residential</b><font style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;"><b> <em data-td-fact-id="29242986" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;">1</em></b><b>-<em data-td-fact-id="29242987" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;">4</em> Family and Equity Lines of Credit Real Estate:</b> The residential <em data-td-fact-id="29242988" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;">1</em>-<em data-td-fact-id="29242989" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;">4</em> family and home equity real estate loans are generally secured by owner-occupied <em data-td-fact-id="29242990" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;">1</em>-<em data-td-fact-id="29242991" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;">4</em> family residences. The Company&rsquo;s portfolio of home equity loans totaled <em data-td-fact-id="29242992" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;">$4.8</em> million and <em data-td-fact-id="29242993" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;">$4.7</em> million, at <em data-td-invalid-detail="1" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;"> December 31, 2017 </em>and <em data-td-fact-id="29242994" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;">2016,</em> respectively, the majority of which were secured by <em data-td-fact-id="29242995" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;">first</em> liens, or by <em data-td-fact-id="29242996" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;">second</em> liens on properties where the Company also holds the <em data-td-fact-id="29242997" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;">first</em> lien. Repayment of these loans is primarily dependent on the personal income and credit rating of the borrowers. Credit risk in these loans can be impacted by economic conditions within the Company&rsquo;s market areas that might impact either property values or a borrower&rsquo;s personal income. Risk is mitigated by the fact that the loans are of smaller individual amounts and spread over a large number of borrowers. </font></p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 28.8pt; text-align: left; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;"><b>Commercial Real Estate:</b><font style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;"> Commercial real estate loans typically involve larger principal amounts, and repayment of these loans is generally dependent on the successful operations of the property securing the loan or the business conducted on the property securing the loan. These loans are viewed primarily as cash flow loans and secondarily as loans secured by real estate. Credit risk in these loans <em data-td-invalid-detail="1" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;"> may </em>be impacted by the creditworthiness of a borrower, property values and the local economy in the Company&rsquo;s market area. </font></p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 28.8pt; text-align: left; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">During <em data-td-fact-id="29242998" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;">2016,</em> the Company initiated a program to originate loans under the Small Business Administration (&ldquo;SBA&rdquo;) <em data-td-fact-id="29242999" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;">7a</em> program. These loans are secured by commercial real estate and, in accordance with the SBA <em data-td-fact-id="29243000" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;">7a</em> program, are guaranteed at <em data-td-fact-id="29243001" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;">75%</em> of the principal balance. The Company has sold the <em data-td-fact-id="29243002" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;">75%</em> guaranteed portion of the loans originated, retaining servicing on the loans sold, and has retained the remaining <em data-td-fact-id="29243003" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;">25%</em> of these loans. In addition, during <em data-td-fact-id="29243004" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;">2017</em> the Company originated a loan under the United States Department of Agriculture (&ldquo;USDA&rdquo;) program, which guarantees <em data-td-fact-id="29243005" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;">80%</em> of the principal balance.</p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 28.8pt; text-align: left; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;"><b>Construction and Land:</b><font style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;"> Construction and land loans are usually based upon estimates of costs and estimated value of the completed project and include independent appraisal reviews and a financial analysis of the developers and property owners. Sources of repayment of these loans <em data-td-invalid-detail="1" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;"> may </em>include permanent loans, sales of developed property or an interim loan commitment from the Company until permanent financing is obtained. These loans are considered to be higher risk than other real estate loans due to their ultimate repayment being sensitive to interest rate changes, general economic conditions and the availability of long-term financing. Credit risk in these loans <em data-td-invalid-detail="1" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;"> may </em>be impacted by the creditworthiness of a borrower, property values and the local economy in the Company&rsquo;s market area. </font></p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 28.8pt; text-align: left; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;"><b>Commercial</b><font style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;"><b> Business</b><b>:</b> The commercial business loan portfolio includes loans to commercial customers for use in financing working capital needs, equipment purchases and expansions. The loans in this category are repaid primarily from the cash flow of a borrower&rsquo;s principal business operation. Credit risk in these loans is driven by creditworthiness of a borrower and the economic conditions that impact the cash flow stability from business operations. </font></p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 28.8pt; text-align: left; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;"><b>Consumer:</b><font style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;"> The consumer loan portfolio consists of various term and line of credit loans such as automobile loans and loans for other personal purposes. Repayment for these types of loans will come from a borrower&rsquo;s income sources that are typically independent of the loan purpose. Credit risk is driven by consumer economic factors (such as unemployment and general economic conditions in the Company&rsquo;s market area) and the creditworthiness of a borrower. </font></p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<div id="PGNUM" style="width: 100%; text-align: center; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">F-16</div>

<hr style="border: currentColor; border-image: none; width: 100%; height: 2px; color: rgb(0, 0, 0); page-break-after: always; background-color: rgb(0, 0, 0);">
<div id="PGHDR" style="width: 100%; text-align: left;"><a href="#toc">Table of Contents</a></div>

<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: left; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: center; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 12pt;"><b>New Bancorp, Inc.</b></p>

<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: center; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;"><b>Notes to Consolidated Financial Statements</b></p>

<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: center; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;"><b><em data-td-invalid-detail="1" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;">December 31, 2017 </em>and <em data-td-fact-id="29243010" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;">2016</em></b></p>

<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: left; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 28.8pt; text-align: left; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;"><i><b>Internal Risk Categories</b></i></p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 28.8pt; text-align: left; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">The <font style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">Company has adopted a standard loan grading system for all loans. Loans are selected for a grading review based on certain characteristics, including concentrations of credit and upon delinquency of <em data-td-fact-id="29243011" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;">90</em> days or more. Definitions are as follows:</font></p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 28.8pt; text-align: left; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;"><b>Pass</b><font style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;"><i>: </i>Loans categorized as Pass are higher quality loans that do <em data-td-fact-id="29243012" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;">not</em> fit any of the other categories described below.</font></p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 28.8pt; text-align: left; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;"><b>Special Mention</b><font style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;"><b>/Watch</b>: The loans identified as special mention/watch have an obvious flaw or a potential weakness that deserves special management attention, but which has <em data-td-fact-id="29243013" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;">not</em> yet impacted collectability. These flaws or weaknesses, if left uncorrected, <em data-td-invalid-detail="1" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;"> may </em>result in the deterioration of the prospects of repayment or the deterioration of the Company&rsquo;s credit position. </font></p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 28.8pt; text-align: left; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;"><b>Substandard</b><font style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">:<i> </i>These are loans with a well-defined weakness, where the Company has a serious concern about the borrower&rsquo;s ability to make full repayment if the weaknesses are <em data-td-fact-id="29243014" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;">not</em> corrected. The loan <em data-td-invalid-detail="1" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;"> may </em>contain a flaw, which could impact the borrower&rsquo;s ability to repay, or the borrower&rsquo;s continuance as a &ldquo;going concern&rdquo;. When collateral values are <em data-td-fact-id="29243015" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;">not</em> sufficient to secure the loan and other weaknesses are present, the loan <em data-td-invalid-detail="1" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;"> may </em>be rated substandard. A loan will also be graded substandard when full repayment is expected, but it must come from the liquidation of collateral. One-to-<em data-td-fact-id="29243016" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;">four</em> family residential real estate loans and home equity loans that are past due <em data-td-fact-id="29243017" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;">90</em> days or more with loan to value ratios greater than <em data-td-fact-id="29243018" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;">60</em> percent are classified as substandard. </font></p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 28.8pt; text-align: left; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;"><b>Doubtful</b><font style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">: These are loans with major defined weaknesses, where future charge-off of a part of the credit is highly likely. The primary repayment source is <em data-td-fact-id="29243019" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;">no</em> longer viable and the viability of the secondary source of repayment is in doubt. The amount of loss is uncertain due to circumstances within the credit that are <em data-td-fact-id="29243020" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;">not</em> yet fully developed and the loan is rated &ldquo;Doubtful&rdquo; until the loss can be accurately estimated. </font></p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 28.8pt; text-align: left; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;"><b>Loss</b><font style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">: These are loans that represent near term charge-offs. Loans classified as loss are considered uncollectible and of such little value that it is <em data-td-fact-id="29243021" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;">not</em> desirable to continue carrying them as assets on the Company&rsquo;s financial statements, even though partial recovery <em data-td-invalid-detail="1" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;"> may </em>be possible at some future time. </font></p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<div data-thunderdome-xbrl-exclude="1" id="PGBK" style="width: 100%; margin-right: 0pt; margin-left: 0pt;">

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 28.8pt; text-align: left; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">A loan is considered impaired, in accordance with the impairment accounting guidance (ASC <em data-td-fact-id="29243027" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;">310</em>-<em data-td-fact-id="29243028" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;">10</em>-<em data-td-fact-id="29243029" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;">35</em>-<em data-td-fact-id="29243030" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;">16</em>), when based on current information and events, it is probable the <font style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">Company will be unable to collect all amounts due from the borrower in accordance with the contractual terms of the loan. Impaired loans include nonperforming multi-family and commercial loans but also include loans modified in troubled debt restructurings. </font></p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: left; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 28.8pt; text-align: left; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">The Company had <em data-td-fact-id="29243035" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;">no</em> loans modified in a troubled debt restructuring during th<font style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">e years ended <em data-td-invalid-detail="1" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;"> December 31, 2017 </em>and <em data-td-invalid-detail="1" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;"> December 31, 2016. </em></font></p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 28.8pt; text-align: left; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">The <font style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">Company had <em data-td-fact-id="29243036" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;">no</em> troubled debt restructurings modified in the years ended <em data-td-invalid-detail="1" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;"> December 31, 2017 </em>and <em data-td-fact-id="29243037" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;">2016</em> that subsequently defaulted. A loan is considered to be in payment default once it is <em data-td-fact-id="29243038" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;">30</em> days contractually past due under the loan&rsquo;s modified terms. </font></p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 28.8pt; text-align: left; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">In order to determine whether a borrower is experiencing financial difficulty, an evaluation is performed of the probability that the borrower will be in payment default on any of its debt in the foreseeable future without the modification. This evaluation is performed under the <font style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">Company&rsquo;s internal underwriting policy. </font></p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<div data-td-parse-id="1" data-td-statement-type="note" data-td-v2v-id="1521299677661" id="thunderdome-statement-848080">
<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt;"><b>Note <em data-td-fact-id="29243042" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;">6:</em>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; </b><font style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;"><b>Loan Servicing</b></font></p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 28.8pt; text-align: left; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">Loans serviced for others are <em data-td-fact-id="29243043" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;">not</em> included in the accompanying <font style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">consolidated balance sheets. The risks inherent in servicing assets relate primarily to changes in prepayments that result from shifts in interest rates. The unpaid principal balances of mortgage and other loans serviced for others were <em data-td-fact-id="29243044" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;">$70.1</em> million and <em data-td-fact-id="29243045" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;">$50.5</em> million at <em data-td-invalid-detail="1" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;"> December&nbsp;</em><em data-td-fact-id="29243046" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;">31,</em> <em data-td-fact-id="29243047" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;">2017</em> and <em data-td-fact-id="29243048" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;">2016,</em> respectively. Loans serviced at <em data-td-invalid-detail="1" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;"> December 31, 2017 </em>includes <em data-td-fact-id="29243049" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;">$26.4</em> million of SBA loans. </font></p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 28.8pt; text-align: left; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">The <font style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">Company&rsquo;s advances&nbsp;totalling <em data-td-fact-id="29243062" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;">$9.0</em> million and <em data-td-fact-id="29243063" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;">$10.0</em> million&nbsp;at <em data-td-invalid-detail="1" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;"> December 31, 2017 </em>and <em data-td-fact-id="29243064" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;">2016,</em>&nbsp;the Federal Home Loan Bank are all at fixed rates of interest. The advances are secured by a pledge of certain eligible mortgage loans, totaling <em data-td-fact-id="29243065" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;">$38.7</em> million and <em data-td-fact-id="29243066" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;">$23.9</em> million at <em data-td-invalid-detail="1" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;"> December 31, 2017 </em>and <em data-td-fact-id="29243067" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;">2016,</em> respectively, and the Company&rsquo;s investment in FHLB stock. The advances are subject to restrictions or penalties in the event of prepayment. At <em data-td-invalid-detail="1" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;"> December 31, 2017, </em>the Company had the ability to borrow additional advances from the FHLB totaling <em data-td-fact-id="29243068" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;">$11.2</em> million. </font></p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 28.8pt; text-align: left; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">The <font style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">Company had <em data-td-fact-id="29243069" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;">no</em> outstanding federal funds purchased at <em data-td-invalid-detail="1" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;"> December 31, 2017 and $1.0 million outstanding at December 31, 2016 year ended.. </em></font></p>

<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: center; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 28.8pt; text-align: left; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">As of <font style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;"><em data-td-invalid-detail="1" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;"> December 31, 2017 </em>and <em data-td-fact-id="29243076" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;">2016,</em> the net deferred tax asset was fully reserved. Management recorded a valuation allowance against the net deferred tax asset at <em data-td-invalid-detail="1" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;"> December 31, 2017 </em>and <em data-td-fact-id="29243077" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;">2016,</em> based on consideration of, but <em data-td-fact-id="29243078" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;">not</em> limited to, the Company&rsquo;s cumulative pre-tax losses during the past <em data-td-fact-id="29243079" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;">three</em> years, the composition of recurring and non-recurring income from operations over the past several years and the magnitude of recent taxable income as compared to net operating loss carryforwards. When determining the amount of deferred tax assets that are more-likely-than-<em data-td-fact-id="29243080" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;">not</em> to be realized, and therefore recorded as a benefit, the Company conducts a regular assessment of all available information. This information includes, but is <em data-td-fact-id="29243081" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;">not</em> limited to, taxable income in prior periods, projected future income and projected future reversals of deferred tax items. Based on these criteria, the Company determined that it was necessary to maintain a full valuation allowance against the entire net deferred tax asset. </font></p>

<p style="margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 28.8pt; text-align: left; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 28.8pt; text-align: left; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">The Company had a total valuation allowance on its deferred tax assets of <em data-td-fact-id="29243082" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;">$2.6</em> million and <em data-td-fact-id="29243083" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;">$4.5</em> million at <em data-td-invalid-detail="1" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;"> December 31, 2017 </em>and <em data-td-fact-id="29243084" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;">2016,</em> respectively. The decrease in the valuation allowance on deferred income taxes was due primarily to a write down of the Company<font style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">&rsquo;s net deferred tax assets, which was attributable to the change in federal income tax rates pursuant to the Tax Cuts and Jobs Act (the &ldquo;Tax Act&rdquo;) enacted in <em data-td-invalid-detail="1" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;"> December 2017.&nbsp; </em>The new Tax Act had the effect of changing the corporate tax rate to <em data-td-fact-id="29243085" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;">21%</em> and accordingly, the Company adjusted the carrying value of the deferred tax assets to reflect the new rate.</font></p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: center; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 12pt;"><b>New Bancorp, Inc.</b></p>

<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: center; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;"><b>Notes to Consolidated Financial Statements</b></p>

<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: center; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;"><b><em data-td-invalid-detail="1" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;">December 31, 2017 </em>and <em data-td-fact-id="29243086" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;">2016</em></b></p>

<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: center; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: center; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 28.8pt; text-align: left; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">The Company<font style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">&rsquo;s net operating loss of <em data-td-fact-id="29243087" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;">$12.2</em> million at <em data-td-invalid-detail="1" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;"> December 31, 2017, </em>will be carried forward to use against future federal taxable income. The net operating loss carryforwards begin to expire in the year ending <em data-td-invalid-detail="1" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;"> December 31, 2030. </em>Indiana net operating loss carryforwards totaled <em data-td-fact-id="29243088" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;">$1.0</em> million at <em data-td-invalid-detail="1" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;"> December 31, 2017 </em>and will begin to expire in the year ending <em data-td-invalid-detail="1" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;"> December 31, 2024. </em></font></p>

<p style="margin: 0pt 7.5pt; text-align: left; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 28.8pt; text-align: left; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">Retained earnings at both <em data-td-invalid-detail="1" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;"> December 31, 2017 </em>and <em data-td-fact-id="29243089" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;">2016,</em> includes approximately <em data-td-fact-id="29243090" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;">$1.5</em> million for which <em data-td-fact-id="29243091" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;">no</em> deferred federal income tax liability has been recognized. This amount represents an allocation of income to bad debt deductions for tax purposes only. Reduction of amounts so allocated for purposes other than tax bad debt losses or adjustments arising from carryback of net operating losses would create income for tax purposes only, which would be subject to the then-current corporate income tax rate. The deferred income tax liability on the preceding amount that would have been recorded if it was expected to reverse into taxable income in the foreseeable future was approximately <em data-td-fact-id="29243092" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;">$315,000</em> and <em data-td-fact-id="29243093" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;">$510,000</em> at <em data-td-invalid-detail="1" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;"> December 31, 2017 </em>and <em data-td-fact-id="29243094" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;">2016,</em> respectively.</p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 28.8pt; text-align: left; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">As of <font style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;"><em data-td-invalid-detail="1" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;"> December 31, 2017 </em>and <em data-td-fact-id="29243095" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;">2016,</em> the Company had <em data-td-fact-id="29243096" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;">no</em> unrecognized tax benefits or accrued interest and penalties recorded. The Bank does <em data-td-fact-id="29243097" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;">not</em> expect the total amount of unrecognized tax benefits to significantly increase within the next <em data-td-fact-id="29243098" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;">twelve</em> months. The Company will record interest and penalties as a component of income tax expense.</font></p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 28.8pt; text-align: left; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">The Company is subject to U.S. federal and Indiana income tax. The Company is <em data-td-fact-id="29243099" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;">no</em> longer subject to examination by taxing authorities for years prior to <em data-td-fact-id="29243100" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;">201</em><font style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;"><em data-td-fact-id="29243101" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;">4.</em> </font></p>

<p style="margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 28.8pt; text-align: left; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<div contenteditable="false" docsect="9" id="11481" sectdesc="Note to Financial Statements">&nbsp;</div>

<div data-td-parse-id="1" data-td-statement-type="note" data-td-v2v-id="1521299718482" id="thunderdome-statement-848089">
<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt;"><b>Note <em data-td-fact-id="29243102" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;">10:</em>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; </b><font style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;"><b>Regulatory Matters</b></font></p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 28.8pt; text-align: left; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">The <font style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">Bank is subject to various regulatory capital requirements administered by the federal banking agencies. Failure to meet minimum capital requirements can initiate certain mandatory- and possibly additional discretionary- actions by regulators that, if undertaken, could have a direct material effect on the Bank&rsquo;s financial statements. Under capital adequacy guidelines and the regulatory framework for prompt corrective action, the Bank must meet specific capital guidelines that involve quantitative measures of the Bank&rsquo;s assets, liabilities and certain off-balance-sheet items as calculated under regulatory accounting practices. The Bank&rsquo;s capital amounts and classification are also subject to qualitative judgments by the regulators about components, risk weightings and other factors. Furthermore, the Bank&rsquo;s regulators could require adjustments to regulatory capital <em data-td-fact-id="29243103" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;">not</em> reflected in these financial statements. </font></p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 28.8pt; text-align: left; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">Quantitative<font style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;"> measures established by regulation to ensure capital adequacy requires the Bank to maintain minimum amounts and ratios (set forth in the table below), of total capital, Tier <em data-td-fact-id="29243104" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;">1</em> capital and common equity Tier <em data-td-fact-id="29243105" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;">1</em> capital (as defined in the regulations) to risk-weighted assets (as defined) and of Tier <em data-td-fact-id="29243106" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;">1</em> leverage capital to average total assets. </font></p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 28.8pt; text-align: left; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">Basel III was effective for the Company on <em data-td-invalid-detail="1" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;"> January 1, 2015. </em>Basel III requires the Company and the Bank to maintain minimum amounts and ratios of common equity tier <em data-td-fact-id="29243107" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;">1capital</em> to risk weighted assets, as defined in the regulation. Under the new Basel III rules, in order to avoid limitations on capital distributions, including dividends, the Company must hold a capital conservation buffer above the adequately capitalized common equity tier <em data-td-fact-id="29243108" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;">1</em> capital to risk-weighted assets ratio. The capital conservation buffer is being phased in from <em data-td-fact-id="29243109" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;">zero</em> percent to <em data-td-fact-id="29243110" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;">2.50</em> percent by <em data-td-fact-id="29243111" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;">2019.</em> Under Basel III, the Company and Bank elected to opt-out of including accumulated other comprehensive income in regulatory capital.</p>

<p style="margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 28.8pt; text-align: left; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: center; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;"><b>Notes to Consolidated Financial Statements</b></p>

<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: center; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;"><b><em data-td-invalid-detail="1" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;">December 31, 2017 </em>and <em data-td-fact-id="29243112" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;">2016</em></b></p>

<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: center; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: left; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 28.8pt; text-align: left; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">Management believes, as of <font style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;"><em data-td-invalid-detail="1" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;"> December 31, 2017 </em>and <em data-td-fact-id="29243113" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;">2016,</em> that the Bank meets all capital adequacy requirements to which it is subject. </font></p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 28.8pt; text-align: left; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">As of <font style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;"><em data-td-invalid-detail="1" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;"> December 31, 2017 </em>and <em data-td-fact-id="29243114" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;">2016,</em> the most recent notification categorized the Bank as well capitalized under the regulatory framework for prompt corrective action. To be categorized as well capitalized, the Bank must maintain minimum total risk-based, Tier <em data-td-fact-id="29243115" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;">1</em> risk-based, common equity Tier <em data-td-fact-id="29243116" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;">1,</em> and Tier <em data-td-fact-id="29243117" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;">1</em> leverage capital ratios as set forth in the table. There are <em data-td-fact-id="29243118" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;">no</em> conditions or events since that notification that management believes have changed the Bank&rsquo;s category. </font></p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: center; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;"><b><em data-td-invalid-detail="1" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;">December 31, 2017 </em>and <em data-td-fact-id="29243119" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;">2016</em></b></p>

<p style="margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 28.8pt; text-align: left; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">The Bank is subject to certain restrictions on the amounts of dividends that it <em data-td-invalid-detail="1" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;"> may </em>declare without prior regulatory approval. Generally, the Bank<font style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">&rsquo;s payment of dividends is limited to net income for the current year plus the <em data-td-fact-id="29243120" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;">two</em> preceding calendar years, less capital distributions paid over the comparable time period. At <em data-td-invalid-detail="1" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;"> December 31, 2017, </em>dividends available for dividend declaration without prior regulatory approval totaled <em data-td-fact-id="29243121" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;">$520,000</em>. </font></p>

The funds will accrue interest at a rate of <em data-td-fact-id="29243143" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;">4.50%.</em> The Company has accrued <em data-td-fact-id="29243144" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;">$66,000</em> and recognized expense for this plan totaling <em data-td-fact-id="29243145" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;">$22,000</em> during the year ended <em data-td-invalid-detail="1" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;"> December 31, 2017</em>. </font></p>

<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: center; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 12pt;"><b>New Bancorp, Inc.</b></p>

<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: center; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;"><b>Notes to Consolidated Financial Statements</b></p>

<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: center; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;"><b><em data-td-invalid-detail="1" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;">December 31, 2017 </em>and <em data-td-fact-id="29243150" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;">2016</em></b></p>

<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: left; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: left; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 28.8pt; text-align: left; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">The <font style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">Company maintained participation in the Plan for the years ended <em data-td-invalid-detail="1" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;"> December 31, 2017 </em>and <em data-td-fact-id="29243151" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;">2016.</em> The Employee Identification Number (EIN) is <em data-td-fact-id="29243152" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;">13</em>-<em data-td-fact-id="29243153" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;">5645888</em> and the <em data-td-fact-id="29243154" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;">three</em>-digit plan number is <em data-td-fact-id="29243155" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;">333.</em> The Plan operates as a multi-employer plan for accounting purposes and as a multiple-employer plan under the Employee Retirement Income Security Act of <em data-td-fact-id="29243156" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;">1974</em> and the Internal Revenue Code <em data-td-fact-id="29243157" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;">413</em>(c). There are <em data-td-fact-id="29243158" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;">no</em> collective bargaining agreements in place that require contributions to the Plan. The Company has frozen this Plan effective <em data-td-fact-id="29243159" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;">2011.</em> The Plan is administered by the trustees of the Financial Institutions Retirement Fund. Plan contributions and expense were approximately <em data-td-fact-id="29243160" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;">$73,000</em> and <em data-td-fact-id="29243161" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;">$66,000,</em> for the years ended <em data-td-invalid-detail="1" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;"> December 31, 2017 </em>and <em data-td-fact-id="29243162" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;">2016,</em> respectively. The Company&rsquo;s funded status in the Plan at <em data-td-invalid-detail="1" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;"> December 31, 2017 </em>and <em data-td-fact-id="29243163" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;">2016</em> was approximately <em data-td-fact-id="29243164" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;">97.20%</em> and <em data-td-fact-id="29243165" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;">97.15%,</em> respectively. </font></p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 28.8pt; text-align: left; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">Total contributions made to the Pentegra DB Plan as reported on the Form <em data-td-fact-id="29243166" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;">5500,</em> <font style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">equal <em data-td-fact-id="29243167" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;">$153.2</em> million and <em data-td-fact-id="29243168" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;">$163.1</em> million for the plan years ended <em data-td-invalid-detail="1" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;"> June 30, 2016 </em>and <em data-td-fact-id="29243169" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;">2015,</em> respectively. The Company&rsquo;s contributions to the Pentegra DB Plan are <em data-td-fact-id="29243170" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;">not</em> more than <em data-td-fact-id="29243171" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;">5%</em> of the total contributions to the Pentegra DB Plan. </font></p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 28.8pt; text-align: left; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">The <font style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">Company has a retirement savings <em data-td-fact-id="29243172" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;">401</em>(k) plan covering substantially all employees. Employees attain eligibility in the <em data-td-fact-id="29243173" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;">401</em>(k) plan upon completing <em data-td-fact-id="29243174" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;">one</em> year of service and being <em data-td-fact-id="29243175" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;">21</em> years of age or older. Employees <em data-td-invalid-detail="1" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;"> may </em>contribute amounts, up to the federal limitations, of their compensation with the Company matching <em data-td-fact-id="29243176" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;">3%</em> of the employee&rsquo;s total contributions. Employer contributions charged to expense were <em data-td-fact-id="29243177" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;">$34,000</em> and <em data-td-fact-id="29243178" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;">$19,000,</em> for the years ended <em data-td-invalid-detail="1" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;"> December 31, 2017 </em>and <em data-td-fact-id="29243179" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;">2016,</em> respectively. </font></p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 28.8pt; text-align: left; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">As part of the Company<font style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">&rsquo;s stock conversion, shares were purchased by the ESOP with a loan from New Bancorp, Inc. All employees of the Bank meeting certain tenure requirements are entitled to participate in the ESOP. The ESOP acquired <em data-td-fact-id="29243180" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;">55,728</em> shares of the Company&rsquo;s common stock in the conversion. During the years ended <em data-td-invalid-detail="1" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;"> December 31, 2017 </em>and <em data-td-fact-id="29243181" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;">2016,</em> a total of <em data-td-fact-id="29243182" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;">2,975</em> and <em data-td-fact-id="29243183" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;">2,732</em> shares, respectively, were allocated to ESOP plan participants, leaving <em data-td-fact-id="29243184" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;">47,235</em> unallocated shares in the ESOP at <em data-td-invalid-detail="1" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;"> December 31, 2017. </em>Compensation expense related to the ESOP was <em data-td-fact-id="29243185" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;">$45,000</em> and <em data-td-fact-id="29243186" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;">$29,000</em> for the years ended <em data-td-invalid-detail="1" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;"> December 31, 2017 </em>and <em data-td-fact-id="29243187" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;">2016,</em> respectively. </font></p>

<p style="margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 28.8pt; text-align: left; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 28.8pt; text-align: left; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">The stock price at the formation date was <em data-td-fact-id="29243188" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;">$10.00.</em> The aggregate fair value of the <font style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;"><em data-td-fact-id="29243189" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;">47,235</em> unallocated shares was <em data-td-fact-id="29243190" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;">$912,000</em> based on the <em data-td-fact-id="29243191" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;">$19.30</em> closing price of the common stock on <em data-td-invalid-detail="1" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;"> December 31, 2017. </em></font></p>

<p style="margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 28.8pt; text-align: left; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 28.8pt; text-align: left; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">In the event the ESOP is unable to satisfy the obligation to repurchase the shares held by each beneficiary upon the beneficiary<font style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">&rsquo;s termination or retirement, the Company is obligated to repurchase the shares. At <em data-td-invalid-detail="1" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;"> December 31, 2017 </em>and <em data-td-fact-id="29243192" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;">2016,</em> the fair value of these shares was <em data-td-fact-id="29243193" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;">$160,000</em> and <em data-td-fact-id="29243194" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;">$73,000,</em> respectively. There are <em data-td-fact-id="29243195" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;">no</em> outstanding shares held by former employees that are subject to an ESOP related repurchase option. </font></p>

<p style="margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 28.8pt; text-align: left; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 28.8pt; text-align: left; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">In <em data-td-invalid-detail="1" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;"> June 2017, </em>the Company<font style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">&rsquo;s stockholders authorized the adoption of the New Bancorp, Inc. <em data-td-fact-id="29243196" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;">2017</em> Equity Incentive Plan (the <em data-td-fact-id="29243197" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;">&ldquo;2017</em> Plan&rdquo;). <em data-td-fact-id="29243198" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;">No</em> more than <em data-td-fact-id="29243199" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;">97,524</em> shares of the Company&rsquo;s common stock <em data-td-invalid-detail="1" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;"> may </em>be issued under the <em data-td-fact-id="29243200" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;">2017</em> Plan, of which a maximum of <em data-td-fact-id="29243201" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;">69,660</em> <em data-td-invalid-detail="1" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;"> may </em>be issued pursuant to the exercise of stock options and <em data-td-fact-id="29243202" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;">27,864</em> <em data-td-invalid-detail="1" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;"> may </em>be issued pursuant to restricted stock awards, restricted stock units and unrestricted share awards. Stock options awarded to employees <em data-td-invalid-detail="1" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;"> may </em>be incentive stock options or non-qualified stock options. The shares that <em data-td-invalid-detail="1" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;"> may </em>be issued <em data-td-invalid-detail="1" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;"> may </em>be authorized but unissued shares or treasury shares. The <em data-td-fact-id="29243203" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;">2017</em> Plan permits the grant of incentive awards in the form of options, stock appreciation rights, restricted share and share unit awards, and performance share awards. The <em data-td-fact-id="29243204" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;">2017</em> Plan contains annual and lifetime limits on certain types of awards to individual participants.</font></p>

<p style="margin: 0pt 7.5pt; text-align: left; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 28.8pt; text-align: left; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">Awards <em data-td-invalid-detail="1" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;"> may </em>vest or become exercisable only upon the achievement of performance measures or based solely on the passage of time after award. <font style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">&nbsp;Stock options and restricted stock awards provide for accelerated vesting if there is a change in control (as defined in the <em data-td-fact-id="29243205" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;">2017</em> Plan).</font></p>

<p style="margin: 0pt 7.5pt; text-align: left; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 28.8pt; text-align: left; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">On <em data-td-invalid-detail="1" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;"> June 30, 2017, </em>the Company made awards of restricted shares and granted stock options for <em data-td-fact-id="29243206" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;">22,931</em> and <em data-td-fact-id="29243207" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;">60,080</em> shares, respectively, to members of the Board of Directors and to certain members of management. The awards vest over a <em data-td-fact-id="29243208" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;">five</em> year period and the stock options have a <em data-td-fact-id="29243209" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;">ten</em> year period to expiration.<font style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">&nbsp; Each option has an exercise price of <em data-td-fact-id="29243210" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;">$14.09</em> as determined on the grant date and expires <em data-td-fact-id="29243211" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;">10</em> years from the grant date. </font></p>

<p style="margin: 0pt 7.5pt; text-align: left; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 28.8pt; text-align: left; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">The expected volatility was based on the historical volatility of share price for the Company.<font style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">&nbsp; The risk-free interest rate was based on the U.S. Treasury yield curve and expected life of the options at the time of grant.&nbsp; The dividend yield was <em data-td-fact-id="29243219" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;">0.00%</em> as the Company does <em data-td-fact-id="29243220" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;">not</em> currently anticipate paying a dividend.&nbsp; The expected life was based on the average of the <em data-td-fact-id="29243221" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;">five</em> year vesting period and the <em data-td-fact-id="29243222" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;">ten</em> year contractual term of the stock option plan.&nbsp; The exercise price for the stock options was based on the closing price of the Company&#39;s stock on the date of grant.&nbsp; </font></p>

<p style="margin: 0pt 7.5pt; text-align: left; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 28.8pt; text-align: left; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;"><b>Restricted Shares</b></p>

<p style="margin: 0pt 7.5pt; text-align: left; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 28.8pt; text-align: left; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">Restricted shares are accounted for as fixed grants using the fair value of the Company&#39;s stock at the time of the grant.<font style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">&nbsp; Unvested restricted shares <em data-td-invalid-detail="1" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;"> may </em><em data-td-fact-id="29243223" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;">not</em> be disposed of or transferred during the vesting period.</font></p>

<div data-td-parse-id="1" data-td-statement-type="note" data-td-v2v-id="1521299779840" id="thunderdome-statement-848096">
<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt;"><b>Note <em data-td-fact-id="29243227" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;">13:</em>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; </b><font style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;"><b>Earnings (Loss) Per Share</b></font></p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 28.8pt; text-align: left; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">Basic earnings (loss) per share is calculated by dividing net income (loss) applicable to common stock by the weighted-average number of shares of common stock outstanding during the period.<font style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">&nbsp; Unallocated common shares held by the Company&rsquo;s Employee Stock Ownership Plan (the &ldquo;ESOP&rdquo;) are shown as a reduction in stockholders&rsquo; equity and are excluded from weighted-average common shares outstanding for basic and diluted earnings (loss) per share calculations until they are committed to be released. </font></p>

<p style="margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 28.8pt; text-align: left; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 28.8pt; text-align: left; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">Calculations of earnings (loss) per share for the years ended <em data-td-invalid-detail="1" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;"> December 31, 2017 </em>are as follows:</p>

<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: center; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;"><b><em data-td-invalid-detail="1" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;">December 31, 2017 </em>and <em data-td-fact-id="29243232" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;">2016</em></b></p>

<div contenteditable="false" docsect="9" id="11485" sectdesc="Note to Financial Statements">&nbsp;</div>

<div data-td-parse-id="1" data-td-statement-type="note" data-td-v2v-id="1521299805415" id="thunderdome-statement-848098">
<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt;"><b>Note <em data-td-fact-id="29243233" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;">14:</em>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; </b><font style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;"><b>Commitments and Credit Risk </b></font></p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 14.4pt; text-align: left; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;"><i><b>Commitments to Originate Loans</b></i></p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 28.8pt; text-align: left; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">Commitments to originate loans are agreements to lend to a customer as long as there is <em data-td-fact-id="29243234" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;">no</em> violation of any condition established in the contract. Commitments generally have fixed expiration dates or other termination clauses and <em data-td-invalid-detail="1" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;"> may </em>require payment of a fee. Since a portion of the commitments <em data-td-invalid-detail="1" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;"> may </em>expire without being drawn upon, the total commitment amounts do <em data-td-fact-id="29243235" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;">not</em> necessarily represent future cash requirements. Each customer<font style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">&rsquo;s creditworthiness is evaluated on a case-by-case basis. The amount of collateral obtained, if deemed necessary, is based on management&rsquo;s credit evaluation of the counterparty. Collateral held varies, but <em data-td-invalid-detail="1" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;"> may </em>include accounts receivable, inventory, property, plant and equipment, commercial real estate and residential real estate.</font></p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 28.8pt; text-align: left; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">The <font style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">Company&rsquo;s exposure to credit loss in the event of nonperformance by the other party to the financial instrument for commitments to extend credit is represented by the contractual notional amount of those instruments. The Company uses the same credit policies in making commitments and conditional obligations, including receipt of collateral, as those utilized for on-balance-sheet instruments. </font></p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 28.8pt; text-align: left; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">At <font style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;"><em data-td-invalid-detail="1" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;"> December 31, 2017, </em>the Company had outstanding commitments to originate loans aggregating approximately <em data-td-fact-id="29243236" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;">$1.3</em> million, comprised of fixed-rate loans, with interest rates ranging from <em data-td-fact-id="29243237" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;">3.875%</em> to <em data-td-fact-id="29243238" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;">4.875%.</em> At <em data-td-invalid-detail="1" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;"> December 31, 2017, </em>the Company had commitments under undisbursed construction loans totaling <em data-td-fact-id="29243239" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;">$498,000</em> and commitments under commercial and consumer lines of credit totaling <em data-td-fact-id="29243240" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;">$6.7</em> million and <em data-td-fact-id="29243241" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;">$3.8</em> million, respectively. </font></p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 28.8pt; text-align: left; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">At <font style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;"><em data-td-invalid-detail="1" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;"> December 31, 2016, </em>the Company had outstanding commitments to originate loans aggregating approximately <em data-td-fact-id="29243242" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;">$670,000,</em> comprised of fixed-rate loans, with interest rates ranging from <em data-td-fact-id="29243243" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;">3.5%</em> to <em data-td-fact-id="29243244" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;">4.5%.</em> In addition, at <em data-td-invalid-detail="1" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;"> December 31, 2016, </em>the Company had commitments under undisbursed construction loans totaling <em data-td-fact-id="29243245" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;">$1.8</em> million and commitments under commercial and consumer lines of credit totaling <em data-td-fact-id="29243246" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;">$5.5</em> million and <em data-td-fact-id="29243247" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;">$3.8</em> million, respectively. </font></p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 28.8pt; text-align: left; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">The <font style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">Company had commitments under outstanding financial standby letters of credit totaling <em data-td-fact-id="29243248" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;">$169,000</em> and <em data-td-fact-id="29243249" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;">$219,000</em> at <em data-td-invalid-detail="1" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;"> December 31, 2017 </em>and <em data-td-fact-id="29243250" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;">2016,</em> respectively. </font></p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: center; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 12pt;"><b>New Bancorp, Inc.</b></p>

<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: center; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;"><b>Notes to Consolidated Financial Statements</b></p>

<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: center; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;"><b><em data-td-invalid-detail="1" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;">December 31, 2017 </em>and <em data-td-fact-id="29243251" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;">2016</em></b></p>

<p style="margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 28.8pt; text-align: left; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt;">&nbsp;</p>
