<div contenteditable="false" docsect="9" id="11486" sectdesc="Note to Financial Statements">&nbsp;</div>

<div data-td-parse-id="1" data-td-statement-type="note" data-td-v2v-id="1521299855899" id="thunderdome-statement-848099">
<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt;"><b>Note <em data-td-fact-id="29243252" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;">15:</em>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; </b><font style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;"><b>Disclosures about Fair Value of Assets and Liabilities</b></font></p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 28.8pt; text-align: left; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">F<font style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">air value is the exchange price that would be received to sell an asset or paid to transfer a liability (exit price) in the principal or most advantageous market for the asset or liability in an orderly transaction between market participants at the measurement date. Fair value measurements must maximize the use of observable inputs and minimize the use of unobservable inputs. There is a hierarchy of <em data-td-fact-id="29243253" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;">three</em> levels of inputs that <em data-td-invalid-detail="1" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;"> may </em>be used to measure fair value:</font></p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<table border="0" cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0" style="width: 100%; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">

		<tr>
			<td style="width: 43pt;">&nbsp;</td>
			<td style="width: 50pt; vertical-align: top;">
			<p style="text-align: left; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 0pt; margin-right: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt;"><b>Level <em data-td-fact-id="29243254" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;">1</em></b></p>
			</td>
			<td style="vertical-align: top;">
			<p style="text-align: left; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 0pt; margin-right: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt;"><font style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">Quoted prices (unadjusted) for identical assets or liabilities in active markets that the entity has the ability to access as of the measurement date.</font></p>
			</td>
		</tr>

</table>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<table border="0" cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0" style="width: 100%; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">

		<tr>
			<td style="width: 43pt;">&nbsp;</td>
			<td style="width: 50pt; vertical-align: top;">
			<p style="text-align: justify; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 0pt; margin-right: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt;"><b>Level <em data-td-fact-id="29243255" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;">2</em></b></p>
			</td>
			<td style="vertical-align: top;">
			<p style="text-align: justify; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 0pt; margin-right: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt;"><font style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">Significant other observable inputs other than Level <em data-td-fact-id="29243256" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;">1</em> prices such as quoted prices for similar assets or liabilities; quoted prices in markets that are <em data-td-fact-id="29243257" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;">not</em> active; or other inputs that are observable or can be corroborated by observable market data. </font></p>
			</td>
		</tr>

</table>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<table border="0" cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0" style="width: 100%; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">

		<tr>
			<td style="width: 43pt;">&nbsp;</td>
			<td style="width: 50pt; vertical-align: top;">
			<p style="text-align: left; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 0pt; margin-right: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt;"><b>Level <em data-td-fact-id="29243258" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;">3</em></b></p>
			</td>
			<td style="vertical-align: top;">
			<p style="text-align: left; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 0pt; margin-right: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt;"><font style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">Significant unobservable inputs that reflect an entity&rsquo;s own assumptions about the assumptions that market participants would use in pricing an asset or liability. </font></p>
			</td>
		</tr>

</table>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 14.4pt; text-align: left; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;"><i><b>Nonrecurring Measurements</b></i></p>

<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: left; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 27pt; text-align: left; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">Following is a description of the valuation methodologies and inputs used for assets measured at fair value on a non-recurring basis and recognized in the accompanying balance sheet<font style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">s, as well as the general classification of such assets pursuant to the valuation hierarchy. For assets classified within Level <em data-td-fact-id="29243260" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;">3</em> of the fair value hierarchy, the process used to develop the reported fair value is described below.</font></p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<div data-thunderdome-xbrl-exclude="1" id="PGBK" style="width: 100%; margin-right: 0pt; margin-left: 0pt;">
<div id="PGNUM" style="width: 100%; text-align: center; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">F-32</div>

<hr style="border: currentColor; border-image: none; width: 100%; height: 2px; color: rgb(0, 0, 0); page-break-after: always; background-color: rgb(0, 0, 0);">
<div id="PGHDR" style="width: 100%; text-align: left;"><a href="#toc">Table of Contents</a></div>
</div>

<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: left; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: center; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 12pt;"><b>New Bancorp, Inc.</b></p>

<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: center; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;"><b>Notes to Consolidated Financial Statements</b></p>

<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: center; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;"><b><em data-td-invalid-detail="1" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;">December 31, 2017 </em>and <em data-td-fact-id="29243261" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;">2016</em></b></p>

<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: center; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: left; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 28.8pt; text-align: left; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;"><i><b>Collateral-dependent Impaired Loans, Net of ALLL</b></i></p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 28.8pt; text-align: left; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">The estimated fair value of collateral-dependent impaired loans is based on the appraised fair value of the collateral, less estimated cost to sell. Collateral-dependent impaired loans are classified within Level <em data-td-fact-id="29243262" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;">3</em> of the fair value hierarchy.</p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 28.8pt; text-align: left; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">The <font style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">Company considers the appraisal or evaluation as the starting point for determining fair value and then considers other factors and events in the environment that <em data-td-invalid-detail="1" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;"> may </em>affect the fair value. Appraisals of the collateral underlying collateral-dependent loans are obtained when the loan is determined to be collateral-dependent and subsequently as deemed necessary by management. Appraisals are reviewed for accuracy and consistency by management. Appraisers are selected from the list of approved appraisers maintained by management. The appraised values are reduced by discounts to consider lack of marketability and estimated cost to sell if repayment or satisfaction of the loan is dependent on the sale of the collateral. These discounts and estimates are developed by management by comparison to historical results. </font></p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 28.8pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: -15.3pt; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;"><i><b>Unobservable (Level <em data-td-fact-id="29243263" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;">3</em>) Inputs</b></i></p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 28.8pt; text-align: left; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">The following table <font style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">presents quantitative information about unobservable inputs used in nonrecurring Level <em data-td-fact-id="29243264" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;">3</em> fair value measurements: </font></p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: left; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: center; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 12pt;"><b>New Bancorp, Inc.</b></p>

<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: center; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;"><b>Notes to Consolidated Financial Statements</b></p>

<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: center; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;"><b><em data-td-invalid-detail="1" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;">December 31, 2017 </em>and <em data-td-fact-id="29243268" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;">2016</em></b></p>

<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: left; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: left; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">The following methods were used to estimate the fair value of all other financial instruments recognized in the accompanying balance sheets at amounts other than fair value.<font style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">&nbsp;</font></p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 14.4pt; text-align: left; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;"><i><b>Cash and <font style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">Due from Banks and Interest-bearing Demand Deposits</font></b></i></p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 28.8pt; text-align: left; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">The carrying amount approximates fair value.<font style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">&nbsp;</font></p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 14.4pt; text-align: left; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;"><i><b>Interest-<font style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">earning Time Deposits in Banks</font></b></i></p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 28.8pt; text-align: left; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">The carrying amount approximates fair value.<font style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">&nbsp;</font></p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 14.4pt; text-align: left; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;"><i><b>Federal Funds Sold</b></i></p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 28.8pt; text-align: left; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">The carrying amount approximates fair value.<font style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">&nbsp;</font></p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 14.4pt; text-align: left; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;"><i><b>Loans<font style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">&nbsp;and Loans Held for Sale</font></b></i></p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 28.8pt; text-align: left; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">Fair value is estimated by discounting the future cash flows using the market rates at which similar notes would be made to borrowers with similar credit ratings and for the same remaining maturities. The market rates used are based on current rates the <font style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">Company would impose for similar loans and reflect a market participant assumption about risks associated with nonperformance, illiquidity, and the structure and term of the loans along with local economic and market conditions. </font></p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 14.4pt; text-align: left; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;"><i><b>Federal Home Loan Bank Stock</b></i></p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 28.8pt; text-align: left; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">Fair value is estimated at book value due to restrictions that limit the sale or transfer of such securities.<font style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">&nbsp;</font></p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 14.4pt; text-align: left; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;"><i><b>Accrued Interest Receivable and Payable</b></i></p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 28.8pt; text-align: left; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">The carrying amount approximates fair value. The carrying amount is determined using the interest rate, balance and last payment date.<font style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">&nbsp;</font></p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 14.4pt; text-align: left; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;"><i><b>Servicing Rights</b></i></p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 28.8pt; text-align: left; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">S<font style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">ervicing rights do <em data-td-fact-id="29243269" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;">not</em> trade in an active, open market with readily observable prices. Accordingly, fair value is estimated using discounted cash flow models having significant inputs of discount rate, prepayment speed and default rate. </font></p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 14.4pt; text-align: left; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;"><i><b>Deposits</b></i></p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 28.8pt; text-align: left; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">Fair value of term deposits is estimated by discounting the future cash flows using rates of similar deposits with similar maturities. The market rates used were obtained from a knowledgeable independent <em data-td-fact-id="29243270" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;">third</em> party and reviewed by the <font style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">Company. The rates were the average of current rates offered by local competitors of the Company. </font></p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<div data-thunderdome-xbrl-exclude="1" id="PGBK" style="width: 100%; margin-right: 0pt; margin-left: 0pt;">
<div id="PGNUM" style="width: 100%; text-align: center; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">F-35</div>

<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: center; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;"><b>Notes to Consolidated Financial Statements</b></p>

<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: center; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;"><b><em data-td-invalid-detail="1" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;">December 31, 2017 </em>and <em data-td-fact-id="29243271" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;">2016</em></b></p>

<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: left; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: left; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 28.8pt; text-align: left; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">The estimated fair val<font style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">ue of demand, NOW, savings and money market deposits is the book value since rates are regularly adjusted to market rates and amounts are payable on demand at the reporting date. </font></p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 14.4pt; text-align: left; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;"><i><b>Federal Funds Purchased</b></i></p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 28.8pt; text-align: left; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">The carrying amount approximates fair value.<font style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">&nbsp;</font></p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 14.4pt; text-align: left; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;"><i><b>F<font style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">ederal Home Loan Bank Advances</font></b></i></p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 28.8pt; text-align: left; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">Fair value is estimated by discounting the future cash flows using rates of similar advances with similar maturities. These rates were obtained from current rates offered by FHLB.<font style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">&nbsp;</font></p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 14.4pt; text-align: left; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;"><i><b>Commitments to Originate Loans, Letters of Credit and Lines of Credit</b></i></p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 28.8pt; text-align: left; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">The fair value of commitments to originate loans is estimated using the fees currently charged to enter into similar agreements, taking into account the remaining terms of the agreements and the present creditworthiness of the counterparties. For fixed-rate loan commitments, fair value also considers the difference between current levels of interest rates and the committed rates.</p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 28.8pt; text-align: left; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">The fair values of letters of credit and lines of credit are based on fees currently charged for similar agreements or on the estimated cost to terminate or otherwise settle the obligations with the counterparties at the reporting date.<font style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;"> The fair value of loan commitments was <em data-td-fact-id="29243272" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;">not</em> material at <em data-td-invalid-detail="1" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;"> December 31, 2017 </em>and <em data-td-fact-id="29243273" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;">2016.</em> </font></p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 28.8pt; text-align: left; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">&nbsp;</p>
</div>

<div contenteditable="false" docsect="9" id="11487" sectdesc="Note to Financial Statements">&nbsp;</div>

<div data-td-parse-id="1" data-td-statement-type="note" data-td-v2v-id="1521299868758" id="thunderdome-statement-848103">
<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt;"><b>Note <em data-td-fact-id="29243274" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;">16:</em>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; </b><font style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;"><b>Recent Accounting Pronouncements</b></font></p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt;"><i><b>FASB ASU <em data-td-fact-id="29243275" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;">2014</em></b></i><font style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;"><i><b>&#8209;</b></i></font><font style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;"><i><b><em data-td-fact-id="29243276" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;">09,</em> Revenue from Contracts with Customers</b></i></font></p>

<p style="margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 36pt; text-align: left; color: rgb(0, 0, 0); text-indent: 0pt; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt; background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255);">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 36pt; text-align: left; color: rgb(0, 0, 0); text-indent: 0pt; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt; background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255);">In <em data-td-invalid-detail="1" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;"> May&nbsp;</em><em data-td-fact-id="29243277" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;">2014,</em> the Financial Accounting Standards Board (the &ldquo;FASB&rdquo;) issued Accounting Standards Update (&ldquo;ASU&rdquo;) <em data-td-fact-id="29243278" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;">2014&#8209;09,</em> &ldquo;Revenue from Contracts with Customers,&rdquo; which requires an entity to recognize the amount of revenue to which it expects&nbsp;&nbsp; to&nbsp;be entitled for the transfer of promised goods or services to customers. The ASU will replace most existing revenue recognition guidance in U.S.&nbsp;GAAP when it becomes effective. In <em data-td-invalid-detail="1" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;"> March 2016 </em>the FASB issued ASU <em data-td-fact-id="29243279" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;">2016&#8209;08,</em> &ldquo;Principal versus Agent Considerations (Reporting Revenue Gross versus Net),&rdquo; which clarifies the guidance in determining revenue recognition as principal versus agent. In <em data-td-invalid-detail="1" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;"> April&nbsp;</em><em data-td-fact-id="29243280" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;">2016,</em> the FASB issued ASU <em data-td-fact-id="29243281" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;">2016&#8209;10,</em> &ldquo;Identifying Performance Obligations and Licensing,&rdquo; which provides guidance in accounting for immaterial performance obligations and shipping and handling. In <em data-td-invalid-detail="1" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;"> May&nbsp;</em><em data-td-fact-id="29243282" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;">2016,</em> the FASB issued ASU <em data-td-fact-id="29243283" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;">2016&#8209;12,</em> &ldquo;Narrow&#8209;Scope Improvements and Practical Expedients,&rdquo; which provides clarification on assessing the collectability criterion, presentation of sales taxes, measurement date for noncash consideration and completed contracts at transition. This ASU also provides a practical expedient for contract modifications.</p>

<p style="text-indent: 9pt; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 36pt; text-align: left; color: rgb(0, 0, 0); text-indent: 0pt; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt; background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255);">As an emerging growth company, these amendments are effective for annual reporting periods beginning after <em data-td-invalid-detail="1" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;"> December 15, 2018, </em>and for interim periods within annual periods beginning after <em data-td-invalid-detail="1" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;"> December 15, 2019. </em>The Company&rsquo;s revenue is primarily comprised of net interest income on financial assets and financial liabilities, which is explicitly excluded from the scope of ASU&nbsp;<em data-td-fact-id="29243284" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;">2014</em>-<em data-td-fact-id="29243285" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;">09.</em>&nbsp; &nbsp; The Company is continuing to evaluate the impact of adopting ASU <em data-td-fact-id="29243286" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;">2014</em>-<em data-td-fact-id="29243287" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;">09,</em> but does <em data-td-fact-id="29243288" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;">not</em> expect the impact to have a material impact on the Company&rsquo;s financial position or results of operation.</p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: justify; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;"><i><b>FASB ASU <em data-td-fact-id="29243289" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;">2016</em>-<em data-td-fact-id="29243290" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;">01,</em> Recognition and Measurement of Financial Assets and Financial Liabilities</b></i></p>

<p style="margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 36pt; text-align: justify; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 36pt; text-align: justify; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">In <em data-td-invalid-detail="1" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;"> January 2016, </em>the <font style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">Financial Accounting Standards Board (&ldquo;FASB&rdquo;) issued Accounting Standards Update (&ldquo;ASU&rdquo;) <em data-td-fact-id="29243291" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;">2016</em>-<em data-td-fact-id="29243292" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;">01,</em>&nbsp;<i>Recognition and Measurement of Financial Assets and Financial Liabilities</i>. For public business entities, the amendments in this update include the elimination of the requirement to disclose the method(s) and significant assumptions used to estimate fair value that is required to be disclosed for financial instruments measured at amortized cost on the balance sheet, the requirement to use the exit price notion when measuring fair value of financial instruments for disclosure purposes, the requirement to present separately in other comprehensive income the portion of the total change in the fair value of a liability resulting from a change in the instrument-specific credit risk when the entity has elected to measure the liability at fair value in accordance with the fair value option for financial instruments, the requirement for separate presentation of financial assets and financial liabilities by measurement category and form of financial asset (that is, securities or loans and receivables) on the balance sheet or accompanying notes to the financial statements, and the amendments clarify that an entity should evaluate the need for a valuation allowance on a deferred tax asset related to available-for-sale securities in combination with the entity&#39;s other deferred tax assets. </font></p>

<p style="margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 36pt; text-align: justify; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<div data-thunderdome-xbrl-exclude="1" id="PGBK" style="width: 100%; margin-right: 0pt; margin-left: 0pt;">

<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: center; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 12pt;"><b>New Bancorp, Inc.</b></p>

<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: center; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;"><b>Notes to Consolidated Financial Statements</b></p>

<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: center; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;"><b><em data-td-invalid-detail="1" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;">December 31, 2017 </em>and <em data-td-fact-id="29243293" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;">2016</em></b></p>

<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: left; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: left; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 36pt; text-align: left; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">The amendments in this update are effective, as to the Company, for fiscal years beginning after <em data-td-invalid-detail="1" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;"> December 15, 2017, </em>including interim periods within those fiscal<font style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;"> years. Early adoption of the amendments in this update is <em data-td-fact-id="29243294" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;">not</em> permitted, except that early application by public business entities to financial statements of fiscal years or interim periods that have <em data-td-fact-id="29243295" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;">not</em> yet been issued or, by all other entities, that have <em data-td-fact-id="29243296" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;">not</em> yet been made available for issuance are permitted as of the beginning of the fiscal year of adoption for the following amendment: An entity should present separately in other comprehensive income the portion of the total change in the fair value of a liability resulting from a change in the instrument-specific credit risk if the entity has elected to measure the liability at fair value in accordance with the fair value option for financial instruments. An entity should apply the amendments to this update by means of a cumulative-effect adjustment to the balance sheet as of the beginning of the fiscal year of adoption. Management adopted ASU <em data-td-fact-id="29243297" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;">No.</em> <em data-td-fact-id="29243298" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;">2016</em>-<em data-td-fact-id="29243299" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;">01</em> effective <em data-td-invalid-detail="1" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;"> January 1, 2018, </em>without a material impact on the Company&rsquo;s results of operations or financial position. </font></p>

<p style="margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 36pt; text-align: justify; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: justify; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;"><i><b>FASB ASU <em data-td-fact-id="29243300" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;">2016</em>-<em data-td-fact-id="29243301" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;">02,</em> Leases</b></i></p>

<p style="margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 36pt; text-align: justify; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 36pt; text-align: left; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">In <em data-td-invalid-detail="1" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;"> February 2016 </em>the<font style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;"> FASB issued ASU <em data-td-fact-id="29243302" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;">2016</em>-<em data-td-fact-id="29243303" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;">02,</em> <i>Leases.</i> Under the new guidance, lessees will be required to recognize the following for all leases (with the exception of short-term leases) at the commencement date:</font></p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<table border="0" cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0" style="width: 100%; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">

		<tr>
			<td style="width: 90pt;">&nbsp;</td>
			<td style="width: 18pt; vertical-align: top;">
			<p style="text-align: left; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 0pt; margin-right: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt;">&#9679;</p>
			</td>
			<td style="vertical-align: top;">
			<p style="text-align: left; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 0pt; margin-right: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt;">A lea<font style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">se liability, which is a lessee&rsquo;s obligation to make lease payments arising from a lease, measured on a discounted basis; and </font></p>
			</td>
		</tr>

</table>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<table border="0" cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0" style="width: 100%; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">

		<tr>
			<td style="width: 90pt;">&nbsp;</td>
			<td style="width: 18pt; vertical-align: top;">
			<p style="text-align: left; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 0pt; margin-right: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt;">&#9679;</p>
			</td>
			<td style="vertical-align: top;">
			<p style="text-align: left; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 0pt; margin-right: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt;">A right-of-use asset, which is an asset that represents the lessee<font style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">&rsquo;s right to use, or control the use of, a specified asset for the lease term.</font></p>
			</td>
		</tr>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 36pt; text-align: left; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">Under the new guidance, lessor accounting is largely unchanged. Certain targeted improvements were made to align, where necessary, lessor accounting with the lessee accounting model and Topic <em data-td-fact-id="29243304" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;">606,</em> <font style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;"><i>Revenue from Contracts with Customers</i>.</font></p>

<p style="margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 36pt; text-align: left; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 36pt; text-align: left; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">The new lease guidance simplified the accounting for sale and leaseback transactions primarily because lessees must recognize lease assets and lease liabilities. Lessees will <em data-td-fact-id="29243305" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;">no</em> longer be provided with a source of off-balance sheet financing.</p>

<p style="margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 36pt; text-align: left; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 36pt; text-align: left; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">The amendments in ASU <em data-td-fact-id="29243306" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;">2016</em>-<em data-td-fact-id="29243307" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;">02</em> are effective, as to the Company, for years beginning after <em data-td-invalid-detail="1" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;"> December 15, 2019, </em>and for interim periods for years beginning after<font style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;"> <em data-td-invalid-detail="1" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;"> January 1, 2020. </em>Lessees (for capital and operating leases) and lessors (for sales-type, direct financing, and operating leases) must apply a modified retrospective transition approach for leases existing at, or entered into after, the beginning of the earliest comparative period presented in the financial statements. The modified retrospective approach would <em data-td-fact-id="29243308" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;">not</em> require any transition accounting for leases that expired before the earliest comparative period presented. Lessees and lessors <em data-td-invalid-detail="1" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;"> may </em><em data-td-fact-id="29243309" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;">not</em> apply a full retrospective transition approach. Management is currently evaluating the impact of adopting this guidance on the Company&rsquo;s financial statements.</font></p>

<p style="margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 36pt; text-align: left; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: center; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;"><b>Notes to Consolidated Financial Statements</b></p>

<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: center; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;"><b><em data-td-invalid-detail="1" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;">December 31, 2017 </em>and <em data-td-fact-id="29243310" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;">2016</em></b></p>

<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: center; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 36pt; text-align: left; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="margin: 0pt 7.5pt; text-align: justify; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;"><i><b>FASB ASU <em data-td-fact-id="29243311" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;">2016</em></b></i><font style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;"><i><b>&#8209;</b></i></font><font style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;"><i><b><em data-td-fact-id="29243312" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;">09</em> Share</b></i></font><font style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;"><i><b>&#8209;</b></i></font><font style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;"><i><b>Based Payments.</b></i></font></p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 36pt; text-align: left; color: rgb(0, 0, 0); text-indent: 0pt; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt; background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255);">In <em data-td-invalid-detail="1" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;"> March&nbsp;</em><em data-td-fact-id="29243313" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;">2016,</em> the FASB issued ASU <em data-td-fact-id="29243314" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;">2016&#8209;09</em> &ldquo;Share&#8209;Based Payments.&rdquo; The guidance in this ASU simplifies several aspects of the accounting for share&#8209;based payment award transactions, including the income tax consequences, the classification of awards as either equity or liabilities, and the classification on the statement of cash flows. Additionally, the guidance simplifies <em data-td-fact-id="29243315" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;">two</em> areas specific to entities other than public business entities allowing them apply a practical expedient to estimate the expected term for all awards with performance or service conditions that have certain characteristics and also allowing them to make a one&#8209;time election to switch from measuring all liability&#8209;classified awards at fair value to measuring them at intrinsic value.</p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 36pt; text-align: left; color: rgb(0, 0, 0); text-indent: 0pt; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt; background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255);">For emerging growth companies, the amendments are effective for annual periods beginning after <em data-td-invalid-detail="1" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;"> December&nbsp;</em><em data-td-fact-id="29243316" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;">15,</em> <em data-td-fact-id="29243317" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;">2017</em> and interim periods within annual periods beginning after <em data-td-invalid-detail="1" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;"> December&nbsp;</em><em data-td-fact-id="29243318" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;">15,</em> <em data-td-fact-id="29243319" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;">2018.</em>&nbsp;&nbsp;Management does <em data-td-fact-id="29243320" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;">not</em> expect to make material changes to its accounting for share-based payments and implementation of ASU <em data-td-fact-id="29243321" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;">2016</em>-<em data-td-fact-id="29243322" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;">09</em> is <em data-td-fact-id="29243323" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;">not</em> expected to have a material effect on the Company&rsquo;s financial position and results of operations.&nbsp;&nbsp;Additionally, Merchants share-based compensation plan awards have been classified as equity awards, whereby available elections to switch to intrinsic value measurement do <em data-td-fact-id="29243324" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;">not</em> apply.</p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: justify; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: justify; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;"><i><b>FASB ASU <em data-td-fact-id="29243325" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;">2016</em>-<em data-td-fact-id="29243326" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;">13,</em> Financial Instruments <font style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">&ndash; Credit Losses</font></b></i></p>

<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: justify; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;"><i><b>&nbsp;</b></i></p>

<p style="margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 36pt; text-align: left; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">In <em data-td-invalid-detail="1" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;"> June 2016, </em>FASB issued ASU <em data-td-fact-id="29243327" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;">2016</em>-<em data-td-fact-id="29243328" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;">13,</em> &ldquo;Financial Instruments - Credit Losses&rdquo;. The amendments in this Update replace the incurred loss model with a<font style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;"> methodology that reflects expected credit losses over the life of the loan and requires consideration of a broader range of reasonable and supportable information to calculate credit loss estimates. ASU <em data-td-fact-id="29243329" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;">No.</em> <em data-td-fact-id="29243330" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;">2016</em>-<em data-td-fact-id="29243331" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;">13</em> replaces the incurred loss impairment methodology with a new methodology that reflects expected credit losses over the lives of the loans and requires consideration of a broader range of information to inform credit loss estimates. The ASU requires an organization to estimate all expected credit losses for financial assets measured at amortized cost, including loans and held-to-maturity debt securities, based on historical experience, current conditions, and reasonable and supportable forecasts. Additional disclosures are required. ASU <em data-td-fact-id="29243332" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;">No.</em> <em data-td-fact-id="29243333" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;">2016</em>-<em data-td-fact-id="29243334" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;">13</em> is effective, as to the Company, for fiscal years, beginning after <em data-td-invalid-detail="1" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;"> December 15, 2019, </em>and interim periods within those fiscal years. Management expects that the implementation of ASU <em data-td-fact-id="29243335" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;">No.</em> <em data-td-fact-id="29243336" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;">2016</em>-<em data-td-fact-id="29243337" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;">13</em> <em data-td-invalid-detail="1" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;"> may </em>increase the balance of the allowance for loan losses and is continuing to evaluate the potential impact on the Company&#39;s results of operations and financial position.</font></p>

<p style="margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 36pt; text-align: left; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt;">&nbsp;</p>
</div>

<div contenteditable="false" docsect="9" id="11488" sectdesc="Note to Financial Statements">&nbsp;</div>

<div data-td-parse-id="1" data-td-statement-type="note" data-td-v2v-id="1521299877342" id="thunderdome-statement-848104">
<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: left; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;"><b>Note <em data-td-fact-id="29243338" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;">17:</em>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; </b><font style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;"><b>Change in Corporate Form </b></font></p>

<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: left; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 36pt; text-align: left; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">On <em data-td-invalid-detail="1" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;"> October 19, 2015, </em>the <font style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">Bank consummated its mutual &ndash;to-stock conversion pursuant to which it became a Federal stock savings bank and the wholly owned subsidiary of New Bancorp, Inc., as parent of the Bank. </font></p>

<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: center; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 36pt; text-align: left; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;"><font style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">As part of the conversion, the Bank became the wholly owned subsidiary of the Company, and the Company issued and sold shares of its capital stock pursuant to an independent valuation appraisal of the Bank and the Company. The stock was priced at <em data-td-fact-id="29243339" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;">$10.00</em> per share. In addition, the Bank&rsquo;s board of directors adopted an employee stock ownership plan (ESOP) which subscribed for <em data-td-fact-id="29243340" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;">8%</em> of the common stock sold in the offering. The Conversion was completed on <em data-td-invalid-detail="1" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;"> October 19, 2015 </em>and resulted in the issuance of <em data-td-fact-id="29243341" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;">696,600</em> common shares by the Company. </font>The cost of the Conversion and issuing the capital stock <font style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">totaled <em data-td-fact-id="29243342" style="font-style: normal; font-weight: inherit;">$1.2</em> million and was deducted from the proceeds of the offering. </font></p>

<p style="margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 36pt; text-align: left; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 36pt; text-align: left; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">The conversion was accounted for as a change in corporate form with the historic basis of the Bank<font style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">&rsquo;s assets, liabilities and equity unchanged as a result. </font></p>

<p style="margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 36pt; text-align: left; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">&nbsp;</p>
